entities.name: Marika Dennick
entities.description:
Marika Dennick was a character in The Graben Gang.

Marika Dennick found her husband Duv attempting to repair the water recycler, which he christened "Betty", and told him that it was too old and needed to be replaced. His attempt to repair it failed and she suggested he ask Frank for help, only for him to remind her that the last time Frank had helped had been a disaster.

Their daughter Juni asked them to keep it down, as she was trying to listen to her shows on the Communinet Radio. Marika suggested that she do it outside and keep an ear open for wormsign. Duv stated that Sandworm activity had been up 9000% since Zantara took out the Shield Wall, to which Marika asked how Zantara had done that in one day when it had taken Duv six months to build a shed. He resented that comparison, as Zantara was an enemy of the Imperium, which Marika found to be an appealing idea for sexual roleplay, disgusting Juni.

Duv's mother then attempted to chase a Sandworm away. Marika suggested that they charge the Sandworms five Solari per trip through Graben, which Duv replied would allow them to buy a new groundcar. They later learned that a new security inspector, Rix, would be sent to Depot 12 after the previous one had to spend three weeks in a tranquility pod.
entities.short_description: Marika Dennick was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Mesa
entities.description:
Sister Mesa was an adept of the Bene Gesserit.

Mesa was approached by the Prisoner in Arrakeen. She explained to them that she was in hiding there, where the universe would soon turn. She told them that the city was the safest place on Arrakis, with Sandflies to the west and slavers all around. She advised them to be equiped with weapons and ammunition if they intended to travel to the planet's more dangerous territories. They offered to help her and she tasked them with finding texts regarding ancient prophecies of the Fremen.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Sister Mesa was an adept of the Bene Gesserit.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Herbert estate / Legendary / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Morani Twins
entities.description:
The Morami Twins were trained jongleurs.

The twins were performing as part of a troupe of jongleurs in an opera on Giedi Prime when one of the props malfunctioned and killed a guest of Baron Vladimir Harkonnen. They were detained and placed in the slave pens while their troupe was paid off.

The twins were later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Amado Delsin, Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, the Grey Lady, Poyko Nen and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition began, they scaled the Serpent Spire, which would allow them to survey the entire labyrinth. The sister fell, hitting several jagged rocks on the way down, with her brother rushing to her side. They were approached by Delsin, who attacked the brother. The sister had faked her injuries and attacked Delsin from behind. The twins outmanouvered the pirate and killed him.

Scaling the walls, the twins cut off the Fremen's path as he was about to reach Nen. He attacked with his crysknife, proving a formidable opponent even against their acrobatic skills. As he was about to finish them off, they made a quick escape over the wall where he could not follow. The twins later cornered the Grey Lady, who used the Voice to order them to kill each other.
entities.short_description: The Morami Twins were trained jongleurs.

entities.name: Moreg Hreg
entities.description:
Moreg Hreg was the daughter of Morwena Hreg.

Moreg Hreg walked her daughter Nessa down the aisle at her wedding. However, before Nessa could finish saying her vows, Moreg began to bleed from every pore as her body disintegrated into a bubbling pool of gore. It was later discovered that Moreg had been the first victim of what became known as the bad Spice epidemic.

Moreg's mother Morwena was approached by the Prisoner in the Salusan Bull. She told them of Moreg's death and the circumstances that had led to it.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Moreg Hreg was the daughter of Morwena Hreg.

entities.name: Morwena Hreg
entities.description:
Morwena Hreg was the mother of Moreg Hreg and the grandmother of Nessa Hreg.

Morwena Hreg was in The Salusan Bull with Ilith Richese and Orilis Io when she was approached by the Prisoner. She was appalled at them for speaking to her and order them to avert their gaze, threatening to have them flogged. She complained that Justis Clagg was deploying idiots to harass her. She recalled her daughter Moreg walking her granddaughter Nessa down the aisle on her wedding, only for Moreg to disintegrate as Nessa was reading her wedding vows due to the "bad spice" epidemic. She believed the Fremen to be responsible and murdered her beloved handmaiden Farnoosh, who claimed distant Fremen ancestry.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Morwena Hreg was the mother of Moreg Hreg and the grandmother of Nessa Hreg.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Herbert estate / Legendary / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Nahla
entities.description:
Nahla, also known as The Paranoid, was the leader of the Maas Kharet.

Nahla was sent to Arrakis to find the Fremen, but never found them. Seeking to create new and better Fremen, she founded the Maas Kharet.

Nahla was approached by the Prisoner in the O'odham after they had defeated her lieutenants. She told them of her frustration with her mission what led to her creating the Maas Kharet. Seeking to put an end to the voices in her head, she attacked the Prisoner, but was overpowered and fatally stabbed. As she bled to death, she declared that the heavens stood open and scattered their riches and that she must open her hands to gather their wealth. She wondered why she thought of an ambush, poison in her molten cup and why she felt her years. She declared that loves arms beckoned with their naked delights and Eden's promises of ecstasies. She remembered her scars and dreams of old transgressions. She wondered why she slept with fears before falling over dead.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Nahla, also known as The Paranoid, was the leader of the Maas Kharet.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Herbert estate / Legendary / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Nailea Shaffat
entities.description:
Nailea Shaffat was educated at the Suk Medical School.

Shaffat was approached by the Prisoner at her clinic in Arrakeen. She asked why they had come and they told her that they were investigating the death of Osten Laithe and that they suspected foul play. She asked them about the state of the cadaver and they told her that they found froth around the mouth, which made her suspect poison. She told them to acquire a poison snooper to confirm this suspicion, for she did not have one at present.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Nailea Shaffat was educated at the Suk Medical School.

entities.name: Nana
entities.description:
Nana was a character in The Graben Gang.

Nana attempted to drive a Sandworm away from the Graben when her son Duv told her that it could not be driven away as easily as a stray bat. Later when learned that a new security inspector named Rix to inspect Depot 12, she commented that she had once known a man with that name who had been well-endowned, much to the disgust of her son.

Nana overheard a conversation between Duv and Marika in which they discussed the upcoming Spice Cake Competition. Duv hinted at his secret ingredient, to what Nana shouted that if it was not more Spice he was wasting his time, prompting him to tell her to shut up.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Nana was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Nessa Hreg
entities.description:
Nessa Hreg was the daughter of Moreg Hreg.

Nessa Hreg was walked down the aisle by her mother Nessa at her wedding. However, before Nessa could finish saying her vows, Moreg began to bleed from every pore as her body disintegrated into a bubbling pool of gore. Neesa's white dress was left pink from the gore. It was later discovered that Moreg had been the first victim of what became known as the bad Spice epidemic.

Nessa's grandmother Morwena was approached by the Prisoner in the Salusan Bull. She told them of the horrible event that had taken place at Nessa's wedding and the circumstances that had caused them.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Nessa Hreg was the daughter of Moreg Hreg.

entities.name: Nevaldine
entities.description:
Soha Sirrendrin was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in Arrakeen. They asked him if it was a CHOAM vendor and he replied that it was before suspiciously asking if they were from the Committee on Interstallar Traffic and Trade or if Lady Nevaldine had put it up to it.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Soha Sirrendrin was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in Arrakeen. They asked him if it was a CHOAM vendor and he replied that it was before suspiciously asking if they were from the Committee on Interstallar…

entities.name: Noctua
entities.description:
Noctua was sent by Zantara to guide the Prisoner after they arrived on Arrakis. They were arrested by the Sardaukar when they were spotted with her in Harko Village.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Noctua was sent by Zantara to guide the Prisoner after they arrived on Arrakis. They were arrested by the Sardaukar when they were spotted with her in Harko Village.

entities.name: Nola Stein
entities.description:
Captain Nola Stein was a soldier of House Atreides.

Nola Stein was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. She told them that she needed their help, as she was being blackmailed due to a leak. She informed them that someone had filmed an intimate encounter between her and Senior Lieutenant David Inius and told them to locate him at the courtyard of the Atreides residency. The Prisoner later returned with the shigawire and Stein was grateful to them for helping her and Inius and for not reporting them.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Captain Nola Stein was a soldier of House Atreides.

entities.name: Oona Byrn
entities.description:
Oona Byrn was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Oona Byrn travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Venesir Ask, Roella Ramsby, Eulalia Harthorn, Ansel Virro, Bianca Bagetti and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group tp dine with them.

Byrn attended a banquet alongside Harthorn, Virro, Yimari, Ramsby and Bagetti. The attendants all drank poisoned wine and their the masks were also poisoned and sealed to their faces. Byrn attempted to remove her mask, tearing off half of her face before she fainted and died. The scene was later investigated by Dhood Shazz and the Prisoner.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Oona Byrn was a member of the Janusian Faithful.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Herbert estate / Legendary / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Orilis Io
entities.description:
Orilis Io was the grandmother of Cyprian Io.

Orilis Io was in The Salusan Bull with Ilith Richese and Morwena Hreg when she was approached by the Prisoner. She was asked if they were from the Planetologist Office, as she was getting annoyed. They replied that they were not and she could not hear them, hence she engaged her enhanced hearing, declaring it the only thing the Tleilaxu were good for. She bragged that her grandson Cyprian was the Imperial Planetologist on Arrakis. She asked to know if he had been making time for his correspondence with Ariste Atreides in order to woo her, explaining that she, Ilith and Morwena had written the letters.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Orilis Io was the grandmother of Cyprian Io.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Herbert estate / Legendary / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Ormuna Laaks
entities.description:
Ormuna Laaks was approached by the Prisoner at her stall in Harko Village. She told them no to request any repair, construction and renovation work, as she was booked solid for the next eight months. entities.name: Phaedra O'Garee
entities.description:
Phaedra O'Garee was the daughter of Phin and Tidjii O'Garee and the sister of Phin Jr., Brie, Sally and Koda.

Phaedra O'Garee was born on Arrakis to Phin and Tidjii O'Garee. She had four siblings; Phin Jr., Brie, Sally and Koda.

Phaedra and her family were tracking an off-course freighter in the Hagga Basin when their path was blocked by a rock slide. They were then attacked by the Maas Kharet, who accused them of tresspassing on their territory. They attempted to explain that they were just friendly explorers, but the Maas Kharet called them infidels who were defiling the domain of the electric worms. The Maas Kharet prepared to bury them alive, but fled when a Sandworm approached. The O'Garees reached safety on a rock island and once the worm departed, they followed Koda's signal to the Maas Kharet's camp. The O'Garees killed them, took their helmets and Sally found an old map. They then returned to their shop and prepared the helmets for sale.

The O'Garees followed the the map into the Hagga Basin, where they travelled through relentless sandstorms until they reached a testing station where insects were studied. The family hid when a Harkonnen fire team floated down the shaft from above, realising that they had entered a Harkonnen base instead of a testing station. As they attempted to escape, they encountered a Harkonnen captain, whom Sally and Koda killed in a coordinated attack. Once they returned to Arrakeen, Phin presented their findings to Alastair Christian Chim and the O'Garees were rewarded by House Atreides, as the base had been causing them problems for some time and Gurney Halleck had been planning to lead an assault on it.
entities.short_description: Phaedra O'Garee was the daughter of Phin and Tidjii O'Garee and the sister of Phin Jr., Brie, Sally and Koda.

entities.name: Phaedra Vye
entities.description:
Phaedra Vye was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Phaedra Vye travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Venesir Ask, Roella Ramsby, Eulalia Harthorn, Ansel Virro, Bianca Bagetti, Oona Byrn and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group to dine with them.

Phaedra Vye become acquainted with Osten Laithe, later becoming his lover. He told her his deepest secrets and she asked him for money to buy back her family's heirlooms from House Harkonnen. The Prisoner investigated Laithe's workshop and Vye's aparement on the orders of Sub-Prefect Tors. In the apartment, they discovered a secret room where they found Vye's corpse with a blade buried in her neck.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

Ramsby attended a banquet alongside Harthorn, Virro, Yimari, Bagetti and Byrn. She received a note from the butler Theophilus on behalf of Ambrose Lucifera, in which he advised her on a patricular vintage of wine. The attendants all drank poisoned wine and their the masks were also poisoned and sealed to their faces, killing them. The scene was later investigated by Dhood Shazz and the Prisoner.

entities.description:
Sadus was a mysterious Fremen who instructed the Prisoner in the Trials of Aql.

Sadus first appeared to the Prisoner when they entered the first Trial of Aql in Mihna Cavern. As the Prisoner avoided being seen by the observing eyes, she told them of the hardships the Fremen had endured on Harmonthep, where they were forbidden to take part in the Hajj and their children were taken from them and made into slaves. Once they completed the trial, she advised them to remember the suffering of the Fremen.

They were then attacked by the Maas Kharet, who accused them of tresspassing on their territory. They attempted to explain that they were just friendly explorers, but the Maas Kharet called them infidels who were defiling the domain of the electric worms. The Maas Kharet prepared to bury them alive, but fled when a Sandworm approached. The O'Garees reached safety on a rock island and once the worm departed, they followed Koda's signal to the Maas Kharet's camp. The O'Garees killed them, took their helmets and Sally found an old map. They then returned to their shop and prepared the helmets for sale.

Samin Moro was a Mentat in the service of House Harkonnen.

Samin Moro was approached by the Prisoner in Riftwatch and offered to train them the ways of the Mentat. She told them that they would need to provide simple yet necessary tasks to prove their capability before the training could begin. Once these tasks were completed, she informed them that she was skilled in the art of killing, which was very useful to her colleague, Piter de Vries.

entities.name: Sigrid
entities.description:
Sigrid was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Sigrid grew up in Tsimpo with her sister Stisk and their mother. It had been a Harkonnen village, but the villagers were met with indifference when they approached the Harkonnens asking for aid due to a deficiency in the water system. Sigrid and several other young villagers went behind the elders' back to House Atreides and Thufir Hawat agreed to help them, with Duke Leto Atreides assigning his best men to the job. The Harkonnens arrested several Atreides engineers, but Leto sent a garrison to free them and install the younger villagers as the new leadership of the village. Baron Vladimir Harkonnen sent his twisted mentat Piter de Vries, who destroyed Tsimpo and had the young leadership executed, including Sigrid.

Stisk later led her crew of smugglers, consisting of Valentin, Zoe, Maax and Chingo to the ruins of Tsimpo. They found a necklace belonging to Sigrid in buried in the sand and used it open a hidden door in a box canyon. They found a a Mark IV medium CHOAM gunship inside, which they used to smuggle a lot of alcohol back to Carthag.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Sigrid was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Simone Von Konig
entities.description:
Simone Von Konig was a Mentat in the service of House Harkonnen.

Simone Von Konig was approached by the Prisoner at Riftwatch. She informed them that despite being in the service of House Harkonnen, she despised all of its members and only served them to use their resources to accomplish her own goals. She then gave them the task of determining the cause of the recent deaths in Arrakeen. She told them that they needed to conduct the investigation incognito, as her Mentat counterpart in House Atreides, Andrea Ganan, was already investigating the matter. She instructed to begin by infiltating the labor movement known as the Sandflies, which had suffered a similar outbreak. She advised that they investigate the group's involvement with Captain Tighe Skorda and the crash of the Kytherea.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Stisk
entities.description:
Stisk was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Stisk was a smuggler based in Carthag who led a group that included Valentin, Zoe, Chingo and Maax. She and Zoe met with Valentin when he returned from poisoning Argus Veer and he informed them that calls had been made for their arrest on the Communinet Radio stations of both House Harkonnen and the Imperium, with 20 metre holograms of them displayed in the main concourse. Zoe wondered how they could be looking for them and Stisk insisted that the death of Veer would cause the locals to revolt and allow them to escape. Chingo and Maax then arrived after spreading the work of Veer's death. Stisk then revealed that she had blown their cover by falsely reporting the alcohol in the vault they had hit in Tsimpo as destroyed. Zoe and Valentin were angered that Stisk had made it so they could never return to their homes, as she was willing to sabotage her own people due to her vendetta against the Harkonnens. Stisk replied that the people of Carthag could live if they left the city in time, which was more chance than her sister had gotten.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Stisk was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.description:
Syla Krohn was a host of the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen.

Syla Krohn announced to her listeners that she would be their guide and confidant, leading them through gloriuos days under the might of their beloved Baron Vladimir Harkonnen. She then played some music to invigorate her listeners before introducing The Convert.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Symphasia Rai
entities.description:
Symphasia Rai became very popular for her performances with her band, the Dulcet Tones. They had a very successful residency at the Crystal Terrace on Kaitain and she became the most requested singer on House Atreides' Communinet Radio station. She also became a sex symbol among the Dunemen fleet.

Rai was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull in Arrakeen. She was offended that they were not familiar with her and outlined her successful career, explaining that she was the current headliner at The Salusan Bull. She expressed her resentment towards Gurney Halleck, whom she considered to be stealing her spotlight.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Tessa Lim
entities.description:
Tessa Lim was a character in Death on the Titan.

Tessa Lim was an engineer on the Sand Titan. She had a combative relationship with Chief Jarrick Thorne, whom she found incompetent. Thorne died under mysterious circumstances and Tessa was questioned. When asked about the involvement of Riko Marr, she replied that she never told him to steal anything but knew that Thorne had been receiving encrypted messages of the down-low. She admitted that she may have given him the idea to steal the message after seeing him with an injured face. She suggested that Lena Orlov be investigated, suggesting that something was going on between her and Thorne, reacting with disgust when asked if she had such a relationship with Thorne. She suggested that Orlov could only have known known that Marr had been in Thorne's quarters on the night that he was killed if she had been there herself. She then wondered where Jeb Dolan had been on the night, since he had not been present when Marr entered the shigawire hut.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Tessa Lim was a character in Death on the Titan.

entities.name: The Grey Lady
entities.description:
Sister Elara, also known as The Grey Lady, was a deserter of the Bene Gesserit.

Sister Elara a sister of the Bene Gesserit who was renowned for her abilities as a Truthsayer. She was expelled from the Sisterhood for unknown reasons after she challenged the Reverend Mothers. The Sisterhood ordered a manhunt to retrieve her and she went into hiding. Relocating to Arrakis, she established the largest brothel in the sector. She was later arrested on suspiscion of witchcraft.

Elara was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Amado Delsin, Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, Poyko Nen, the Morani Twins and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition began, she entered the Shadow Corridor, where she dispatched a group of poison-spitting creatures with ease. She later encountered Nen, who attacked her and tore off her veil, revealing her scarred and disfigured face. She fled as Kanto arrived and his rock lizards tore Nen apart. She lost Kanto's pursuit and was cornered by the twins, at which point she used the Voice to order them to kill each other.

She reached the innermost chamber of the labyrinth before the Fremen, becoming trapped inside with a Laza tiger. She used the Voice to order it to stand down, but the beast attacked her. The Fremen then entered and the tiger attacked him and he killed it with his crysknife, though the tiger tore off one of his arms before dying. Taking advantage of his wounded state, Elara ordered him to kill himself with the Voice. All of her opponents now dead, Elara rose to her feet and pressed the Conqueror's Seal, winning the game.
entities.short_description: Sister Elara, also known as The Grey Lady, was a deserter of the Bene Gesserit.

entities.name: The Prisoner
entities.description:
The Prisoner was a ghola created by the Bene Tleilax and sent to to Arrakis and find the elusive Fremen.

The Prisoner was created by the Bene Tleilax using genetic material harvested from an unknown corpse.

The Prisoner was summoned by a Reverend Mother, who asked them several questions about their birthplace, caste and training. She then ordered them to kneel before her using the Voice. Compelled, they did as ordered and the Reverend Mother tested them with the Gom Jabbar. During the test, she told them that their mission was to travel to Arrakis and find the Fremen, for everything that the Sisterhood were working towards depended on it.

The Prisoner's character is determined by the choices of the player. In addition to chosing the character's physical appearance, the player must decide the Prisoner's background by answering the following questions by the Reverend Mother:

entities.description:
Tidjii was born into a tomb robbing family on Hagal. As a child, she met Phin O'Garee. Phin's father, who had not conducted the necessary research beforehard, led them in an attempted robbery of a tomb that belonged to a formidable family. Now being hunted, Tidjii and Phin travelled to the furthest planet they could afford to travel to, Arrakis. They later married and had five children; Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie, Sally and Koda.

Tidjii was approached by the Prisoner at her stall in Arrakeen. She discussed the positive and negative aspects of the War of Assassins and recalled the breakdown of the betrothal between Ariste Atreides and Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen. She also told them of the strange things she and her family would find in the deep desert, such as when Sally found a resupply shuttle from Kirana III.

entities.description:
Vera Kotilla was a biologist and co-host of the The Harkonnen Family Games.

Vera Kotilla hosted The Harkonnen Family Games alongside Maxim Dubrov on the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen. They commentated a confrontation between Poyko Nen and the Grey Lady in the challenge known as the Man Trap. Vera commended Poyko's direct attacks, which displayed surprising skill despite his wounds. She was surprised by the strength and speed that the Grey Lady displayed at her age. The Grey Lady's veil was torn off during the fight, revealing scars that seemed familiar to Vera and led her to wonder where she had seen them before. As the fight continued, Vera commented on Poyko's continued ability to hold his ground when Kanto's rock lizards entered the arena. As the Grey Lady retreated to a safe distance, the rock lizards tore Poyko to pieces.

She and Stisk met with Valentin when he returned from poisoning Argus Veer and he informed them that calls had been made for their arrest on the Communinet Radio stations of both House Harkonnen and the Imperium, with 20 metre holograms of them displayed in the main concourse. Zoe was born on Caladan. She left when she was branded a traitor by House Atreides and relocated to Arrakis, where she became a vendor. She became copilots with Valentin, a deserter of House Harkonnen. They stole an Atreides transport and bought their way into the smugglers, who retrofitted a crashed ship called Fallen Light into a base.

Zoe was approached by the Prisoner at the Crossroads. She told them of her history and of the crashed ships in Hagga Rift. She also told them of the Maas Kharet and their murderous actions.

entities.name: Iylyo
entities.description:
Iyolo, or by her matronymic Nyshae, was a Fish Speaker bashar. She fought against Face Dancers who attacked Onn in 13728 AG.

After the battle, she was ordered to make newly promoted sub-bashar Kieuemo’s rank official. For her hard work she was granted a wish for the Emperor Leto. She wished to take a holiday to her home planet Salusa Secundus, for she hadn’t seen her family in years.

Her mother was a woman named Shae, hence the matronymic.

entities.name: Maria I Mustami
entities.description:
Maria I Mustami was a member of House Mustami who governed the Corrino Imperium as regent in 1647–1680 AG, the fifth Maria was the second woman to rule the Imperium.

Maria succeeded her husband, Avelard II Mustami, as regent. During her regency, the exiled Iraklii Harkonnen secretly stimulated significant unrest in the Imperium through the weapons trade; supporting civil disobedience, small-scale civil wars, revolts, religious progroms, and political unrest. In the end, there was so much chaos that Maria was forced to resign her position in 1680. She was succeeded as regent by Damiano Fulgencio.

entities.description:
was the reclusive stepmother of Salvador Corrino. Straight backed and haughty, she has a dislike for many aspects of technology. In the past she was known as the 'Virgin Empress' and was considered a great beauty.

entities.description:
Naib was a Fremen Naib and Fedaykin during the time of the First Spice War.

Kari's sietch was ambushed by House Harkonnen forces. To avoid capture, she slit her wrists with her Crysknife, however she was later found by the House Atreides and brought to their base of operations to be interrogated by the Atreides Mentat Noree Moneo. Moneo tried to initiate friendly contact with Kari, offering her Spice coffee. After she refused, he had to force feed it to her, as to avoid Kari experiencing Spice Melange withdrawal. The rest of Kari's sietch was captured in Sietch Tabr by the Harkonnens. Moneo ordered the Commander to capture Sietch Tabr, but ensure it was not destroyed in the process. Kari exclaimed 'Taqwa'. To her, it was as if they were already dead.

The Commander returned and brought news to Moneo that the Fremen at Tabr were dead. Kari unsheathed her crysknife and held it at Moneo's neck, telling the commander that the Fremen has killed themselves, as to avoid Harkonnen capture, as she had attempted to do. Kari told Moneo that the Fremen were not the allies of the Atreides, and that Dune belonged only to Shai-Hulud. Kari scoffed at Moneo, telling him that the Atreides were so focused on the strength of the Harkonnens that they had neglected to consider the strength of the House Ordos. Kari told the commander that there was a Smuggler starport that had been built on the sacred Fremen Funeral Plain and that the Fremen would consider helping the Atreides cause if they destroyed it.

Much later after the Commander succesfully destroyed the spaceport, the Atreides were led into a trap on the funeral plain by the Corrino. Moneo planned to concentrate their attack on the Ordos, and only fight the Harkonnens should they come to their aid. Moneo looked through his observation telescope and discovered Fremen forces. The Commander looked through the scope and discovered Kari and the Fremen forces declaring their loyalty to the Atreides. Ultimately, the Atreides and Fremen defeated the Ordos and the Harkonnens, before bombing the Padishah Emperor Frederick IV's Hutment and winning the First Spice War.

entities.name: Elara Moray Trieu
entities.description:
Lady Elara Moray Trieu was as an advisor and the concubine of the Padishah Emperor Frederick IV. She authored a letter to Reverend Mother Marius Alethea Blasco, explaining the situation on Arrakis.

A devoted sister of the Bene Gesserit, Elara also lived among the Fremen for a period. During her time with the Fremen, she drank the Water of Life and survived the Weirding ritual. She was capable of using the Voice, attempting to manipulate both the Emperor and even the Reverend Mother Marius.

Lady Elara was the one who brought The Commander to Arrakis on an imperial liner. She introduced herself to them on the ship while in orbit and told them that The Commander would die on Arrakis, before admitting that The Sisterhood of the Bene Gesserit had been wrong before, from time to time. She mentioned that if The Emperor found out she helped them, she would be executed, since he was not particularly compassionate.

She tells the Commander they were here because of a prophecy, that the Bene Gesserit previously studied their bloodline and fate, seeing them die many times. However, since they had also seen the Commander "rise to command vast armies bringing peace to Arrakis.... once" Elara deemed it worth the risk of the Emperor's wrath in bringing them to Dune. The Bene Gesserit believed in this prophecy and seked this very outcome.

entities.description:
The Glutton commanded a base in Khidr's Shadow, where he developed a terrifying reputation as a cannibal who ate his victims while they were still alive.

The Glutton entered his dining room and began to eat one of his victims. He smelled an intruder and called out to them. He told them that they should have washed themself in blood laced with chaumas. He explained that his hunger was unnatural and controlled him. He asked them if they had a similar experience of being controlled by something they could not define. He then attacked them, but was ultimately overpowered and killed.

entities.name: The Jackal
entities.description:
The Jackal was a ghola appointed by the Bene Tleilax to locate the Fremen.

The Jackal was sent to Arrakis to find the Fremen. He became an ally of them, but over time he learned that the Bene Tleilax did not value him or anyone else that they had assigned to locate the Fremen, only about their planned betrothal of Ariste Atreides and Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen.

The Jackal was approached by the Prisoner in an abandoned alleyway in Arrakis. Having visited the Wolf and the Vulture and solved their riddles, they told him they were seeking the footsteps of the worm. He told them that the words were sacred to the Fremen, who would speak them on the hajj in search of their umma. He concluded that they were close to their umma, which signified that they were there to kill him. They admitted that Count Hasimir Fenring had promised them information in exchange for completing the task. He told them that Fenring had been hunting them since Carthag and that many others had been sent before them to seek the Fremen. He urged them to complete the task and seek their answers. He then spoke of how they had all been cast aside and forgotten, telling them that they could complete the mission unless Fenring killed them first. They then strangled him to death with a garotte.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
The Water Shipper was a ghola appointed by the Bene Tleilax to locate the Fremen.

The Water Shipper was subjected to hypno-ligation by the Bene Tleilax. He was sent to Arrakis and acquired a mansion by killing every member of the family who occupied it. He took control of the planet's water, intending to use it to find the Fremen, but they eluded him.

The Water Shipper discovered that the Prisoner had invaded his mansion. He watched them on the transeye and did not recognise them, which disturbed him. He told them of his mission and his failure to find the Fremen. Believing that the Sisterhood had sent them to check on his progress, insisting that he just needed more time in which to complete the mission. However, he drank water that had been poisoned by the Prisoner and attempted to tell them how to break the compulsion, but died before he could do so.

Lanville served as overseer for some of the duties and activities of the Atreides' personal bodyguard and security personnel, as well as aiding in some of the Atreides' military logistics.

On Caladan, Lanville led a technical crew that tended to Duncan Idaho's fighter after he conducted a flight patrol.

entities.name: Alman I
entities.description:
Emperor Alman I (d. 123 AG) was the seventh Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 104–123 AG), succeeding his brother-in-law Elrood I al-Aziz as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

Alman founded the House of Alman Corrino, which for centuries would struggle with the senior House of Saluso Corrino for rule over the Imperium.

Before his rise as emperor, Alman was known as Alman bin Haig. He was thus presumably the son of a man named Haig. Alman was a brother-in-law of Emperor Elrood I al-Aziz (r. 104–123) and thus married to a daughter of Emperor Saudir I (r. 12 BG–70 AG).

In 123, Elrood I was assassinated and Alman replaced him on the throne, founding the House of Alman Corrino. Elrood's nephew and rightful heir, Saudir II Negara II, fled into exile. In 122, Alman brought a bill of attainder before the Landsraad, accusing Elias Atreides of supporting the forces of the exiled prince. Alman was himself assassinated in 123 AG, before the bill could be acted upon. Saudir II then assumed the throne. Among Saudir II's actions as emperor was to reconfirm Elias Atreides in his titles.

entities.name: Alman II
entities.description:
Emperor Alman II was the ninth Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 184–206 AG). He was the son of seventh emperor, Alman I, and presumably usurped the throne from Saudir II Negara II.

Alman II was the son of Alman I (r. 104–123 AG). Alman I was succeeded in 123 by the previously exiled Saudir II Negara II of the original Saluso Corrino line.

Alman II succeeded Saudir II as emperor in 184, Shortly after his accession, Alman II murdered Demetrios IV Atreides, son of Elias Atreides (a known supporter of Saudir II), and had the Atreides lands redistributed.

Alman II ruled until 206, when he was succeeded by his son Alman III.

Emperor Alman IV was the fifteenth Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 345–362 AG). He was the great-grandson of the eleventh emperor, Estil I, and possibly usurped the throne from his predecessor, Wensic I.

In 346 AG, Alman IV executed Thomas II Atreides and attained Jaddua and a planetary fiefdom. Jaddua and the planetary fiefdom had been granted to the Atreides in 207 AG by Emperor Elrood II (of the House of Saluso Corrino), as a reward for their aid in deposing Estil I and securing Elrood II's accession. Alman IV's rise to emperor marked the return of Estil's line, the House of Alman Corrino, to the throne.

Alman IV ruled until 362 AG, when he was succeeded by his brother Wallach I.

entities.name: Audrii I
entities.description:
Emperor Audrii I, also known simply as Audrii Corrino, was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 603–669 AG), the first to rule after the First Protectorate (561–603).

Audrii I was a son of Emperor Shaddam I (r. 482–548, 549–553) and brother of Emperor Ezhar I Palaigodes (r. 553–556). In 556, Ezhar's regent Kalus I al-Qair took power over the Imperium as Protector, beginning the First Protectorate. The Protectorate continued under Kalus's relative Harmon II al-Qair, Iason Atreides was instrumental in resolving the differences between the different branches of House Corrino. In 603, Iason persuaded Harmon to step down as Protector in favor of Audrii I's accession as emperor, ending the Protectorate.

For Iason's efforts, Audrii gave him his daughter Salusa's hand in marriage, and in 635 named him Count Aramanli. Iason used his unprecedented influence over the Imperium to reform the imperial government. The Imperial House's power was further counterbalanced with that of the Landsraad, which for the first time was allowed to begin to have regularly scheduled meetings with CHOAM and the Spacing Guild (previously only dealt with through the emperor). The emperor was also made responsible for his actions to the Imperial Family, itself controlled and balanced by the Imperial Household and Imperial Cousines, further diluting imperial power.

Audrii restored the titles of Count Abulurd III Harkonnen, who had been stripped of them by Harmon for refusing to support the Protector's imperial aspirations. The Harkonnens were however demoted again when Abulurd's son, Iosif Harkonnen, was discovered in bed with Audrii's son.
entities.short_description: Emperor Audrii I, also known simply as Audrii Corrino, was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 603–669 AG), the first to rule after the First Protectorate (561–603).

entities.name: Audrii II
entities.description:
Emperor Audrii II (d. 1027) was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 995–1027 AG), succeeding his cousin Wallach II as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. As a cousin of Wallach, Audrii was a grandson of Elrood III.

In 1027, there was a rupture with the Sardaukar forces. The Sardaukar Bashar usurped the throne, aided by his demicousin Lord Aleksandr IV Harkonnen. Feyd assumed the throne as Emperor Feyd I, founding the House of Feyd, killed all close imperial relations, and suspended the Landsraad. The Corrino heir, the 5 years old Prince Corrin, Wallach II's grandson, was rescued from Feyd's massacre and taken beyond the imperial borders by Paulos II Atreides.

entities.name: Audrii III
entities.description:
Emperor Audrii III reigned as Emperor of the Known Universe five times between 1892 AG and 1993 AG, during the Era of the Princes. He was a cousin of his predecessor, Sidir VI.

Audrii's brief reigns and frequent depositions and restorations were the result of the machinations of House Atreides, economically dominant in this period. Phillipos III Atreides and Markos Atreides forced a rapid turnover of emperors, seeking to prevent any one dynast from achieving too much power.

Audrii first became emperor in 1892 AG, succeeding his cousin Sidir VI. He ruled until 1897, when he was replaced with his second cousin Corrin V. Audrii was restored to the throne in 1937, succeeding Corrin V, though was replaced with Corrin again already in 1938.

Audrii's third reign began in 1961, when he succeeded Sidir VI's son Negara III. He only ruled until 1962, when he was succeeded by Menemtahe III. Audrii was restored for a fourth reign in 1969, again succeeding Corrin V, but was replaced in the same year by Costin IV. Audrii's final restoration to the throne was in 1990, briefly replacing Menemtahe IV, who in turn replaced Audrii in 1993.

entities.description:
Avelard II Mustami, also known simply as Avelard II, was a member of House Mustami who governed the Corrino Imperium as regent in 1624–1647 AG, the fourth

During Avelard's tenure as regent, the Imperium experienced unprecedent economic growth.

One of the side effects of the prosperous Imperium was an increased demand for mentats. Under severe political pressure, Avelard wished the Order of Mentats to expand its training program and alter the size, pace or quality of the training efforts. Avelard came within a whisker of sending troops to Tleilax to force this decision. The troops were composed of united Sardaukar and Landsraad strength. Proctor Makarfo Bonn resisted the regent's demands and persuaded Avelard that neither Imperium, CHOAM, nor Landsraad would gain from 'watered-down' Mentat training. After the crisis, the Tleilaxu claimed that Avelard had retreated due to fear of them resisting with force; this claim has been met with uniform skepticism considering the overbearing strength of the Sardaukar and Landsraad forces.

Mustami's tenure as regent lasted until 1647, when he was succeeded by his wife Maria I Mustami.

entities.name: Aiden
entities.description:
Aiden was a character in The Young Guardians.

Aiden was an infiltrator from House Harkonnen sent with a group to Cala City to pose as aspirants to the House Guard of House Atreides. During his time there, Aiden and his group antagonised Taron, Lyra and Eamon. They were assigned to the Peak of Valor challenge, a two-day endurance race to planet their flag at the summit of Mount Syubi. Aiden and his group reached the summit first and claimed victory by planting their flag.

Aiden entered the commandant's office that day before graduation and stole his code book, but was seen by Taron and Lyra. As he and his group rose to the stage at the graduation ceremony to receive top of class honors, the commandant had them arrested for espionage and treason. Aiden protested, claiming it to be a misunderstanding and demanding to be unhanded. The commandant pointed out that it was wartime and invoked kanly, killing Aiden and his group by slashing their throats.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Aiden was a character in The Young Guardians.

entities.description:

Alastair Christian Chim was approached by the Prisoner in the Matador Room in The Salusan Bull. He explained the rules of the establishment and asked them what they wanted to drink.

entities.name: Alnaëm
entities.description:
Alnaëm ("The Sleeper") was a man sent to Arrakis to locate the Fremen.

He was sent to Arrakis to seek the Fremen. Expecting the villains described by Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV and the Communinet Radio, he was surprised to discover that they were a noble people being drawn into a conspiracy not of their making. Using his Mentat faculties, he discovered signs of the Bene Gesserit and the Missionaria Protectiva seeded amongst the Fremen. He earned their trust and they named him "Alnaëm", a Chakobsa word meaning "The Sleeper". They came to see him as the Lisan al-Gaib and he felt obligated to unite them to achieve the dream of Liet-Kynes. He resolved to drink the Water of Life and become their Mahdi. He suspected that he had been sent to find a particular Fremen and believed the answers he was seeking were beneath Old Carthag. He recorded a solido message at Sietch Ta'lab while being pursued by the Sardaukar, in which he revealed that he had hidden the details of his journey on a minimic film locked in a nearby safe. He ended the recording to lead the Sardaukar away.

Zantara was sent by Stilgar to find Alnaëm after his disappearance. Alnaëm's first recording was found by Ariste Atreides and the Prisoner in Sietch Ta'lab. Learning from the recording that he had hidden another in a nearby safe, they located it. They later met with Zantara in The Salusan Bull, where they used an Ixian decoder to access it and learn the coordinates of where the answers he was seeking could be found.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Amado Delsin
entities.description:
Amado Delsin was a pirate from Lankiveil.

Amado Delsin was born on Lankiveil, where he later became a pirate. He wielded dual sabers, with which he claimed to have killed over 200 men. He was rumored to have plundered entire fleets single-handedly and had affairs with noblewomen across the Imperium. He was captured by the forces of Abulurd Rabban and taken to Giedi Prime, where he was placed in the slave pens.

Delsin was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, the Grey Lady, Poyko Nen, the Morani Twins and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition begans, he fought his way through a pack of swamp vipers. He crossed paths with Tom and a fierce showdown occured between them, which ended with Delsin slicing Tom open and causing his guts to spill out. He then encountered the twins, with the sister being injured from falling from the Serpent Spire. He attacked the brother, but the sister had faked her injuries and attacked Delsin from behind. The twins outmanouvered and killed Delsin.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
Ambrose Lucifera was a member of House Lucifera.

Ambrose Lucifera was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. They told him that they were delivering a gift from a secret admirer and he asked to know who it was. They replied that their patron did not wish to spoil the romance and offered him Caladan wine. He joyously accepted it and asked if they wished to share it, to which they replied that the patron insisted that he enjoy it alone. Little did he know, it was infected with tainted spice.

entities.name: Andohar Noah
entities.description:
Captain Andohar Noah was a character in Death on the Titan.

Andohar Noah was a captain of the Titan. Chief Jarrick Thorne died under suspiscious circumstances after a heated argument with the deckhand, Riko Marr. Noah searched Riko's locker and discovered a coded message from the intelligence division of House Atreides that was addressed to Thorne. He questioned Riko, told him that he had found the message and asked him to come clean. He warned him that the Spice Miner's Guild would allow the crew to kill him to satisfy their desire for vengeance over Thorne's death. Riko insisted that he knew nothing of the message and was being framed.

However, another crew member came forward and stated that he had seen Riko enter the shigawire hut on the night of Thorne's murder. Riko then admitted to taking the message, but denied killing Thorne. Noah demanded to know why Riko had taken the message and he replied that he had hoped it contained incriminating information about Thorne. Noah ordered Riko to place his hand flat on the table, plunging a knife into it once he did. Overcome with pain, Riko confessed to the murder, stating that Tessa Lim had put him up to it.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Captain Andohar Noah was a character in Death on the Titan.

entities.name: Ansel Virro
entities.description:
Graf Ansel Virro was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Ansel Virro travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Roella Ramsby, Oona Byrn, Venesir Ask, Bianca Bagetti, Eulalia Harthorn and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group to dine with them.

Virro attended a banquet alongside Harthorn, Yimari, Ramsby, Bagetti and Byrn, during which he spilled a goblet of wine. They all drank poisoned wine and the masks were also poisoned and sealed to the wearers' faces, causing Virro to choke to death. The scene was later investigated by Dhood Shazz and the Prisoner.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Graf Ansel Virro was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

entities.name: Anton Tolliver
entities.description:
Anton Tolliver was a soldier of House Atreides.

Anton Tolliver fought as a soldier of House Atreides in the War of Assassins. During the conflict, he developed a rivalry with Maxim Kazmir, an intelligence agent of House Harkonnen. He was assigned a mission by Duke Leto Atreides in which he was station in The Anvil Tradepost.

Tolliver approached Kazmir and informed him that a cousin of his had died. He was disgusted by Kazmir's nonchalant reaction and stated that he would be stuck there forever, as even his own Harkonnen masters despised him. They almost attacked each other until Tyg Rolsum and reminded them of the laws of Kanly. He was approached by the Prisoner and informed them of his mission. He asked them to locate an undercover agent of House Atreides who had gone missing and whom he believed Kazmir was searching for, requesting that they discover what became of him. He provided them with coordinates of his location and warned them that they would have to do a lot of climing.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Areg
entities.description:
Areg was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Areg was a pyon who served House Harkonnen in Carthag. As he prepared to test a long throw cutteray auger with Dayvan and Ufim, he overheard Davyan say that he had dinner with Baron Vladimir Harkonnen. He was amazed, only for Ufim to point out that Davyan was being sarcastic. Dayvan agreed, but pointed out that they had direct orders from Piter de Vries. Once everything was set up, they activated the cutteray, only for it to go out of phase, vaporize the beam splitter and empty the charge onto Areg. He was literally cooked alive and died screaming.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Areg was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Argus Veer
entities.description:
Argus Veer was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Argus Veer was a renowned gladiator who was celebrated as the greatest in the Known Universe. He eventually retired to Grumman and did not fight for seven years, but returned when he was commissioned by Glossu Rabban to fight at a festival in Carthag on Arrakis.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Argus Veer was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Aric Thorne
entities.description:
Sergeant Aric Thorne was a soldier of House Atreides.

Aric Thorne was born on Caladan to Fiona Thorne. He was a member of Gurney's Own, an elite strike force that served House Atreides in the War of Assassins. He was part of a raid against a position of House Harkonnen in Three Rock Station. Between battles, Aric sent recordings to his mother in which he spoke of his belief in the Atreides' cause despite the hardships they faced. As the conflict continued, many Atreides soldiers died, including dear friends of Aric's. The horrors he witnessed caused Aric to lose his faith in the conflict, including seeing Atreides operatives committing despicable acts. He told his mother that he feared he would never see her again and was declared missing later that same month. His disappearance devastated his mother and caused her to question the purpose of the war.

Redondo Monroe played recordings of Aric's messages and Fiona's diaries on an episode of Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines, though much of the recordings were heavily edited due to her critical and damaging comments about the war.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Sergeant Aric Thorne was a soldier of House Atreides.

entities.name: Arn Mikals
entities.description:
Arn Mikals was the creator of the Paladin 9200 Combat Training Program.

Arn Mikals was assigned a lab in Testing Station No. 163 where he created the Paladin 9200 Combat Training Program. He grew found of the thinking machine, which he called "Pal", and regarded it as his best friend. Mikals was later informed that the project had been shut down and ordered to destroy the Paladin system. He refused to do it and dismissed his staff and was determined to convince the comittee to change their minds. He told Pal that he would return shortly, though he never did, presumably being imprisoned or killed for his defiance.

The Prisoner entered the lab and discovered Pal, as well as Mikals' last recording before his departure. From the recording, they learned the passcode they could use to access the Paladin system. Once they did, Pal mistook them for Mikals and was overjoyed at their reunion.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Arn Mikals was the creator of the Paladin 9200 Combat Training Program.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

He also told them what he knew of the Maas Kharet, such as their stealing of water and their hatred of the Fremen despite claiming to be Fremen themselves. He warned that while their leader Nahla was not a Sayyadina, she was very powerful and had a strong hold on her believers.

They asked him if he had ever met a Navigator and he replied that he worked in the Accounting department and tried to avoid Navigators and Steersmen as much as possible. He compared the sensation of being in the presence of one to having maggots writhing around inside one's skull. He expressed a disinterest in the politics of Arrakeen, viewing the city as being beneath him.

Campos Demari was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in in Arrakeen. He told them of his past as a pilot and all that he know about the spice trade. He also told them about his charter service, Dune Riders, in which he offered ornithopter excursions into the deep desert, which he declared to be the only charter service that guaranteed wormsign.

entities.description:
Chingo was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Chingo was a smuggler based in Carthag who was part of a group led by Stisk that included Valentin, Zoe and Maax. Valentin poisoned Argus Veer and Maax and Chingo were sent by Stisk to spread the word of his death. They met with the rest of the group afterwards, with Chingo being surprised by how angry the news made the locals. He asked who Veers was, with Maax stating that he had already told him that Veer was the greatest gladiator in 300 years. Chingo replied that he did not watch blood sports, as he preferred Cheops.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Chingo was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Creel
entities.description:
Sergeant Creel was a soldier of House Atreides.

Creel was a member of the Second Deep Desert Expeditionary Force. They received a report from scouts of House Harkonnen bastion in Dejum Wati. Seven Atreides cohorts were deployed in a coordinated attack and they were victorious, despite the Harkonnen troops being more viscious than normal. Despite the victory, heavy losses were sustained and Creel was traumatised and disillusioned by the experience.

Creel recounted his experience at Dejum Wati to Redondo Monroe on Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines. During the interview, he expressed cynicism over the principles of Kanly and the Great Convention, as he and his fellow soldiers had done things that drained them of their humanity. Monroe attempted to steer the conversation in a more positive direction by asking about moments of hope and comraderie, but Creel recalled fleeting bright moments within an overwhelming darkness and. He concluded by revealing that he was haunted by horrific experiences and struggled the celebrate the successes and victories. Monroe thanked Creel for his service, which was little comfort to him.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Sergeant Creel was a soldier of House Atreides.

entities.name: Cyprian Io
entities.description:
Cyprian Io was an Imperial Planetologist.

Cyprian Io grew up resenting his older brother, the Na-Duke of their family, who spent all of his time at the capital while Cyprian was kept at their estate. Cyprian was taught at an academy by tutors and scholars and at age eight he was kidnapped by a gang of Opeeachean thugs. He negotiated with one of the members, Portifoy, and convinced him to betray the others and return him to his home. Portifoy was rewarded by being appointed as Cyprian's bodyguard. As an adult, Cyprian was appointed as an Imperial Planetologist by his great uncle, Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV.

Cyprian was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. He ordered Portifoy to get rid of them, but reconsidered when he thought of the lecture that his grandmother, Orilis Io, would give him. He told them of his childhood and his duties as an Imperial Planetologist. He took offence when they asked him about his credentials, claiming the position was his birthright. He asked them if Hasimir Fenring had put them up to it, stating that Fenring knew he held no authority on Arrakis.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
Dakkar was stationed alongside many other Sardaukar on Arrakis during the War of Assassins to ensure that production of the Spice Melange continued uninterrupted.

Dakkar travelled by Ornithopter alongside two of his fellow Sardaukar to investigate a distress signal from the wreckage of the Proteus. The other 'thopters were shot down and he emerged alone, where he found the Fremen outlaw Zantara and the Prisoner. Recognising Zantara, he mockingly told him that he had watched his men take their last tortured breaths on the walls of Arsunt. The two then fought and while Dakkar managed to wound Zantara's leg, the Fremen stabbed him in the torso and caused him to fall to his knees before slitting his throat.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Darko Draganov
entities.description:
Darko Draganov was a host of the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen.

Darko Draganov began his show with the segment "Whispers & Rumors", in which he described reports of vandalism of property of House Harkonnen, promising a fine meal with a Harkonnen official to the first twenty listeners to come forward with the names of culprits. In the segment "Voice of the People", he read a message from Kamelia, who asked how often one should submit a report to the Dune Watch network, to which he advised her to submit a report on a daily basis. In the segment "Baron's Most Wanted", he described Zantara's use of atomics to sunder the Shield Wall, informing his listeners of the one million solari bounty that the Imperium had placed and another million that House Harkonnen was offering for his crysknife. In "Hero of the Day", Draganov told the story of Micah, a seven-year-old boy who reported his own parents to Dune Watch for allowing him to listen to an opera on the Battle of Corrin, which slandered Bashar Abulurd Harkonnen. His parents were detained indefinitely and his future was uncertain, but he would be rewarded by getting to watch the gladiator games in Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's private box.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Darko Draganov was a host of the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen.

entities.name: David Inius
entities.description:
Senior Lieutenant David Inius was a soldier of House Atreides.

David Inius was approached by the Prisoner in the courtyard of the Atreides residency. Deducing that Captain Nola Stein had sent them, he agreed to work with them, but was scaptical. He asked them of their combat experiences and then told them that he and Stein were being blackmailed with a private recording. He admitted that he had convinced Stein not to try and fight it, believing it would go away if ignored. However, the blackmailer used it to extract more information from them, for which Inius blamed himself. He told the Prisoner that he and Stein would meet with the blackmailer in a hidden area behind a tapestry at the CHOAM and suggested they inspect it to try and find something they had overlooked.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Davros
entities.description:
Davros was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Davros was sent to the home of High Prefect Hadyn to announcee that he had grim tidings. Hadyn dismissed his daughters, but ordered his wife to stay. Davros informed him that alcohol had been illegally distributed, resulting in drunken debauchery throughout Carthag. Haydn stated that this was a predictable result of working the pyons harder and taking away their outlets, having advised agains it himself. He suggested that they do nothing, believing that they would wear themselves out before they could cause any unrest. He asked Davros about the crowd's mood and he replied that they were happy and excited to see Argus Veer. He then escorted Haydn to their groundcar to depart for the arena.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Davros was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.description:
Dax Reyder was a representative of House Mikarrol in the Landsraad.

Dax Reyder was approached by the Prisoner on a cliff southwest of The Slant in Jabal Eifrit Al-Janub.

entities.name: Dayvan
entities.description:
Dayvan was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Dayvan was called for breakfast by his mother, who informed him that there was only tea to drink, as she was saving what little bread they had for dinner. He reminded her that he would not be home for dinner that night or any time soon, as he was on double shift until further notice. He told her that he had no choice, for the Harkonnens were cracking down hard and his friend Ufim's cousin had disappeared. His mother was angry, but he warned her to keep quiet, for the Harkonnens were listening. He then convinced her to say the traditional words of praise of Baron Vladimir Harkonnen, despite her reluctance.

He then told her that Zantara was to blame for the increased workload, as he had destroyed the last phased ion refinery in the Northern Precinct. He cursed the Fremen, for which she chastised him, as his paternal grandmother had been a Fremen. He replied that he was glad that the Fremen had been wiped out, believing them to have practices cannibalism, but she told them these were lies by the Imperium and the Fremen only extracted water from the dead. He informed her that due to Zantara's actions they would be testing a long throw cutteray auger with an ungraded barrel, which could easily be dangerous. She forbade him to get involved, but he insisted that he must and she warned him to be careful, fearing that something bad was about to take place.

As the pyons prepared to fire the cutteray, Ufin warned Dayvan how risky the exercise was. Dayvan agreed, but pointed out that they had direct orders from Piter de Vries. Once everything was set up, they activated the cutteray, only for it to go out of phase, vaporize the beam splitter and empty the charge onto Areg, killing him. The rest of the pyons were ordered to continue their shifts. Returning home later, Dayvan informed his mother of what happened. Hearing a commotion outside, Dayvan went out and asked Droba what was happening. Droba informed him that Glossu Rabban had announced a festival with music food and gladiator matches, in which the famed Argus Veer would fight for the first time in seven years. Excited, Dayvan informed his mother, who shamed him for forgetting the death of his friend. Davyan felt sorry, knowing that Areg would have loved to see Argus Veer.
entities.short_description: Dayvan was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Derek Chinara
entities.description:
Derek Chinara was a planetary ecologist.

Derek Chinara was born on Kaitain. He studied to be an ecologist in college and idolised the planetologist Pardot Kynes. He got on the wrong side of Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV's great nephew, Cyprian Io. He received a letter from Pardot's child, Liet-Kynes, requesting his help with a terraforming project. He agreed and travelled to Arrakeen, though Liet was lost in battle before he arrived and Chinara was forced to work with the new planetologist, Io, whom he despised and considered unworthy of the position. He was given a groundcar and an ancient sinkchart of the old botanical testing stations and tasked with documenting their operational status. He inspected two of the stations but was unable to continue due to constant attacks by bandits infected with an unknown ailment.

Chinara was approached by the Prisoner at his camp in Hagga Basin. He told them of his past and the difficulties he had faced on Arrakis. He offered to teach them planetary ecology if they recovered a manifest containing a foll log of supplies from one of the testing stations.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Derek Chinara was a planetary ecologist.

entities.description:
Desmond Mercer was a representative of House Hurata in the Landsraad.

Desmond Mercer was approached by the Prisoner on a cliff to the north of Imperial Testing Station No. 10 in the Eastern Vermillius Gap.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Category:House Tseida Awakening

entities.name: Dhood Shazz
entities.description:
Dhood Shazz was the sheriff of Arrakeen.

Dhood Shazz became suspiscious when the Janusian Faithful arrived on Arrakis and kept largely to themselves, refusing to dine with House Atreides or allow anyone outside their circle to dine with them. He observed their gatherings and kept files on them, determined to discover any secret agendas. The nobles always wore masks during their gatherings, preventing him from discovering their identities.

Shazz entered a banquet hall in Arrakeen to investigate the deaths of its occupants. He was approached by the Prisoner and told them to leave, by the order of Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV. They told him that they wished to speak with someone, to which he informed them that most of the attendees were dead. They told him that they needed to find out if Sub-Prefect Tors was among them and he allowed them to investigate and identify the corpses. They later returned after questioning the butler, Theophilus and the dying Marchioness Eulalia Harthorn. He observed the caskets and discovered that they had not been poisoned. He had Ambrose Lucifera, who had supplied the wine, dragged in and interrogated by the Prisoner, who determined that he had not poisoned the wine. They identified Graf Ansel Virro, Agade Yimari, Roella Ramsby, Oona Byrn and Lady Bianca Bagetti before they were interrupted by the arrival of Tors.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Dhood Shazz was the sheriff of Arrakeen.

entities.name: Dragomir Halil
entities.description:
Dragomir Halil was approached by the Prisoner at his slave pit in Harko Village. He outlined the variety of slaves he had on offer and described the benefits of owning slaves. He also spoke of the shortage of pleasure slaves due to Glossu Rabban buying most of them to motivate the workers in the Neo-Carthag construction project.

Dren Silar was approached by the Prisoner in a cave to the north of the Gasp in Hagga Rift.

entities.name: Droba
entities.description:
Droba was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Droba was present when Glossu Rabban announced a festival with music, food and the legendary gladiator Argus Veer's first fight in seven years. Excited, he travelled with a crowd through the streets of Carthag. He was approached by his friend Dayvan, who asked him what was happening. Droba told him the news and them moved on with the rest of the crowd.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Droba was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Duv Dennick
entities.description:
Duv Dennick was a character in The Graben Gang.

Duv awoke one morning when his neighbor Franklin Munt flies past in an Ornithopter he built himself, which he then crashed. Duv asked if he was okay and Frank replied that it was just a flesh wound. Duv then attempted to get his water recycler working, but found the tools inadequate. His wife Marika told him that the water recycler, which he christened "Betty", was too old and needed to be replaced. Another attempt to repair it failed and Marika suggested he ask Frank for help, only for him to remind her that the last time Frank had helped had been a disaster.

Their daughter Juni asked them to keep it down, as she was trying to listen to her shows on the Communinet Radio. Marika suggested that she do it outside and keep an ear open for wormsign. Duv stated that Sandworm activity had been up 9000% since Zantara took out the Shield Wall, to which Marika asked how Zantara had done that in one day when it had taken Duv six months to build a shed. He resented that comparison, as Zantara was an enemy of the Imperium, which Marika found to be an appealing idea for sexual roleplay, disgusting Juni.

Duv's mother then attempted to chase a Sandworm away. Marika suggested that they charge the Sandworms five Solari per trip through Graben, which Duv replied would allow them to buy a new groundcar. They later learned that a new security inspector, Rix, would be sent to Depot 12 after the previous one had to spend three weeks in a tranquility pod. Frank presented Duv with Gary, a sentry automaton he had created for security purposes. Upon Hix's arrrival, they activated Gary, only for the machine to mistake them for intruders and attack, killing Hix.
entities.short_description: Duv Dennick was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Eamon
entities.description:
Eamon was a character in The Young Guardians.

Eamon was a fifth-born cousin of House Atreides. He attended the War Gym at Cala City where he trained to join the House Guard of Duke Leto Atreides alongside his friends Taron and Lyra. They were antagonised by a group of cadets led by Aiden, who constantly insulted them. They were assigned to the Peak of Valor challenge, a two-day endurance test to plant their flag at the summit of Mount Syubi. As they neared the summit, Lyra fell to a ledge below and told Taron and Eamon to leave her behind, but they refused and rescued her. Aiden's group reached the summit first and planted their flag, but despite their loss Eamon and his friends felt pride in doing the right thing.

Eamon was approached by Taron and Lyra the day before their graduation and they informed him that they had seen Aiden stealing a code book from the commandant's office. Eamon remembered his older brother telling him of an infiltrator from House Harkonnen in their class and concluded that it was Aiden. They informed the commandant, who had Aiden and his group arrested for espionage and treason during the graduation ceremony. As it was wartime, the commandant invoked kanly and killed Aiden and his group be slashing their throats. He then commended the graduates, declaring them the future of House Atreides. Eamon, Taron and Lyra were then assigned to Arrakis.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Eamon was a character in The Young Guardians.

entities.name: Einar Maia
entities.description:
Einar Maia was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in Harko Village. He told them that he had all of the equipment that they would need to collect Spice Melange.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Einar Maia was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in Harko Village. He told them that he had all of the equipment that they would need to collect Spice Melange.

entities.name: Enzo Firenze
entities.description:
Enzo Firenze was a messenger of House Atreides.

Enzo Firenze participated in the Liberation of Ix. He served as the messenger boy for Duncan Idaho. He wore the Messenger Tabard, which the Forms of Kanly dictated should protect him from interference, he was killed when a dying Sardaukar dashed his head apart against the ground.

Enzo's brother Ugo told the Prisoner of Enzo's death on the battlefield and stated that it had given him a taste for killing Sardaukar, which he would never satisfy.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Enzo Firenze was a messenger of House Atreides.

entities.name: Fizel
entities.description:
Fizel was a character in The Graben Gang.

Fizel was a friend of Juni Dennick who was known to dress like a Kirab.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Fizel was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Franklin Munt
entities.description:
Franklin Munt was a character in The Graben Gang.

Frank was a neighbor of Duv Dennick and often helped him with his mechanical needs, though it always ended in disaster. He often made strange additions to technology, such as a fart filter to his stillsuit and a musical accompaniment to a thumper. He greeted Duv one morning in an Ornithopter that he has built, but crashed it immediately afterwords, only suffering a flesh wound. He later created Gary, an automaton intended to defend Depot 12. Inspector Rix arrived and asked to see the security, at which point Frank activated Gary, assuring Rix that no Butlerian proscriptions had been broken. Gary mistook them for intruders and opened fire, killing Rix.

Frank later created the Flavor Enhancer 3000, which he intended to use to help Duv win the Spice Cake competition. He arrived at the competition and had two helpings of the cake made by the competition's usual winner Rashad, as his cake tasted better than ever. Meeting with Duv, he sprinkled the secret ingredient on the cake, which won the competition. However, it caused everyone who ate it to belch profusely, leading to Duv being disqualified.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Franklin Munt was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Ghavouri
entities.description:
Ghavouri was a soldier of House Atreides.

Ghavouri fought in the Battle of Arrakeen, but was drugged by a group of conspirators and kept out of the battle. Feeling dishonored, he spent the next eight years tracking down and destroying them.

Ghavouri was approached by the Prisoner in The Griffin's Reach Tradepost. He was critical of their stance and offered to train them in combat. They agreed and he tasked them with killing the remaining conspirators, promising to train them if they accomplised this.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Ghavouri was a soldier of House Atreides.

entities.name: Gloos Bohannon
entities.description:
Gloos Bohannon was a soldier of House Atreides.

Gloos Bohannon was a soldier in the service of House Atreides in the War of Assassins. He was removed from their service on charges of cowardice, which he denied, insisting that he only served Duke Leto Atreides with honor and integrity.

Bohannon was approached by the Prisoner in Pinnacle Station. He told them of how the Fremen were wiped out by the Sardaukar, with every sietch being burned. He suggested that the Fremen may still be out there, but refused to commit to the idea. He then told them that they may find some Fremen in Harko Village, but warned that they would shadows of their kin. He also told them that the goods sold in Harko were lower than those of Traj Axxari. He warned that there had been a greater presence of Sardaukar and CHOAM mercenaries since the Proteus went down, which had been of great interest to Count Hasimir Fenring.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Gloos Bohannon was a soldier of House Atreides.

entities.description:
Gus acted as a security system for Depot 12, but he was considered ineffective. Knowing that the Spice Miners' Guild would shut them down if the next inspection did not go well, Duv Dennick and Franklin Munt elected to replace him with the automaton, Gary.
