entities.name: Hadyn
entities.description:
High Prefect Hadyn was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Hadyn argued with his wife, stating that House Harkonnen had been punished after the Battle of Windsack because her cousin, Glossu Rabban had destroyed the moonfish industry of Caladan. She questioned how the two were related and he replied that his employer, Count Hasimir Fenring, had spearheaded the investigation into the destruction of Windsack and been heavily invested in the moonfish industry, losing over a third of his fortune when it collapsed. She agreed that if anyone had deliberately caused such a loss to their house, she would skin them alive.

They summonded their daughters, whom he chastised for addressing their mother as if she were a commoner. As they prepared to leave for the arena, the girls were angry to learn that Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen would not be present, instead travelling to Rossak as part of a hunting party. They no longer wished to go, but Hadyn ordered them to, as he had imported their dresses from Chusuk. He told them that they had no chance with Feyd, whose mate would be chosen for political advantage alone.

There was a knock at the door, which Hadyn to reveal Davros, who announced that he had grim tidings. Hadyn dismissed his daughters, but ordered his wife to stay. Davros informed him that alcohol had been illegally distributed, resulting in drunken debauchery throughout Carthag. Haydn stated that this was a predictable result of working the pyons harder and taking away their outlets, having advised agains it himself. He suggested that they do nothing, as Davros reported that the crowd were happy and excited to see Argus Veer, leading Hadyn to believe that they would wear themselves out before they could cause any unrest. They then departed for the arena in their groundcar.
entities.short_description: High Prefect Hadyn was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Hansia Einvald
entities.description:
Hansia Einvald was a renowned design-mentat.

Hansia Einvald became famous for his skills in design, which emulated the ice planet Lankiveil.

The bar in Harko Village known as Hannivar's took much inspiration from the work of Einvald.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Hansia Einvald was a renowned design-mentat.

entities.name: Hanso
entities.description:
Chief Hanso was a crew member of the Mithra.

Hanso was born into a family that had served the Spice Miner's Guild for almost five centuries, eventually becoming a Rig Chief like his father and grandfather had been. He suffered from poor eyesight since childhood and wore corrective lenses. He was stationed on the Mithra when it was shot down in Hagga Basin. He survived alongside Lieutenant Drangh and Quartermaster Nasher Hix, but they were left stranded and surrounded by outlaws. During the crash, his glasses were smashed, rendering him unable to see.

Hanso was approached by the Prisoner and warned them that despite his blindness, he could still kill them if necessary. He expressed his suspiscion that Malek, the captain of the Carryall crew, was responsible for their predicament. He informed them that several of the Dune Men had been abducted by a local criminal element and tasked them with attacking the Kirab camps and recovering the Spice Miners' Guild tags. He provided the Dune Men's last known locations before their signals stopped and wished them good hunting. Once they returned with the tags, he inspected them and found four with names which did not match any member of the Mithras crew. He then tasked them with searching the wreck for survivors, of which they found three.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Chief Hanso was a crew member of the Mithra.

entities.name: Havoc
entities.description:
Lord Havoc was the host of Our Magnificent Galaxy.

Havoc hosted Our Magnificent Galaxy, in which he travelled to different planets to hunt rare creatures. On Salusa Secundus, he sought the Salusan tiger. The Harkonnen troops had spent months on the planet seeking the creature. As the creature was a master of stealth and known for its hypnotizing eyes, he approached quietly when the troops alterted them that they had located the last Salusan tiger and everything was ready for its capture. Once the creature was in sight, the soldiers shot and imprisoned it. Administering a lethal Zenobian injection, they subjected the creature to a slow and agonizing death. As it was dying, Havoc removed its many-colored eyes to keep as trophies.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Lord Havoc was the host of Our Magnificent Galaxy.

entities.name: Heino Flaxenraad
entities.description:
Graf Heino Flaxenraad was the head of a House Minor.

Heino Flaxenraad had five sons. His youngest son Tamzin lived in constant fear that he would be cut off by his father if he did not live up to the expectations placed upon their family.

Tamzin was approached by the Prisoner at the Imperial Consulate in Arrakeen and told them of his fear of being disowned by his father.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Graf Heino Flaxenraad was the head of a House Minor.

entities.name: Ihor
entities.description:
Ihor was a soldier of House Harkonnen and the bodyguard of Myr Charki.

Ihor arrived on Arrakis as part of a patrol of troopers from House Harkonnen. Myr Charki offered them a place to sleep one night. During the night, the rest of the patrol left, with Ihor remaining behind. Chakri made Ihor his silent partner, with him handling the business while Ihor handled the fighting. Ihor never spoke, though whether this was due to an inability or by choice is unknown.

Ihor was standing guard with Chakri when he was approached by the Prisoner at the Griffin's Reach Tradepost.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Ihor was a soldier of House Harkonnen and the bodyguard of Myr Charki.

entities.name: Ilyich Hannivar
entities.description:
Ilyich Hannivar was a former whale-boat captain.

Ilyich Hannivar was born on Lankiveil. In his youth, he was a whale-boat captain and famously caught the fearsome Bjondax whale, Krazinok, which had destroyed thirty boats before he finally took it. As a reward for his achievement, he was granted a bar in Harko Village on Arrakis, which he called Hannivar's. The bones of Krazinok were suspended above the beer hall as a dramatic centrepiece.

Ilyich Hannivar was approached by the Prisoner in Hannivar's. He described the village as a hellhole, but stated that beneath it lay something more important; the lost souls of a thousand drowned sailors.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Ilyich Hannivar was a former whale-boat captain.

entities.name: Ishago Imota
entities.description:
Captain Ishago Imota was a representative of House Imota in the Landsraad.

Ishago Imota was approached by the Prisoner on a cliff to the east of the wreck of the Tisiphone.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Category:House Imota Awakening
entities.short_description: Captain Ishago Imota was a representative of House Imota in the Landsraad.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Herbert estate / Legendary / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Jarrick Thorne
entities.description:
Chief Jarrick Thorne was a character in Death on the Titan.

Jarrick Thorne was the crew chief on the Sand Titan. During his tenure on the ship, he received minimic films containing secret messages from House Atreides. Thorne had a romantic relationship with shift supervisor Lena Orlov. He was on bad terms with engineer Tessa Lim and deckhand Riko Marr, the latter of whom Thorne had a physical confrontation with after learning that Marr had been skimming unprocessed Spice. Thorne died in suspicious circumstances and his remains were found by Orlov, having been pulverised by the mechanical separator.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Chief Jarrick Thorne was a character in Death on the Titan.

entities.name: Jeb Dolan
entities.description:
Jeb Dolan was a character in Death on the Titan.

Jeb Dolan was the communications specialist on the Sand Titan. He was assigned to the shigawire hut, where he was tasked with decoding messages. He was mysteriously absent on the night of crew chief Jarrick Thorne's death and provided a weak alibi, claiming that he was unabel to decipher the minimic film messages that were sent to Thorne by House Atreides.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Jeb Dolan was a character in Death on the Titan.

entities.name: Jovian Huss
entities.description:
Master Inspirator Jovian Huss was the host of The Daily Motivational.

Jovian Huss hosted The Daily Motivational on the Communinet Radio's Harvester Radio station, in which he imparted motivational messages to his listeners.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Master Inspirator Jovian Huss was the host of The Daily Motivational.

entities.name: Kahraman Reis
entities.description:
Kahraman Reis was raised by his mother and father, with the latter becoming addicted to Semuta after the former's death.

Reis was approached by the Prisoner in Harko Village. He told them that he could provide them with fuel, as well as vehicle schematics and tools and packs for repair. He warned them that Arrakis was not a paradise like Chusuk and that ever day there was a battle, with Harko Village in particular driving people to do terrible things they never thought themselves capable of doing. He also told them that Einar Maia had told asked him about a jammed pneumatic stamp three times in the last week.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Kahraman Reis was raised by his mother and father, with the latter becoming addicted to Semuta after the former's death.
entities.image_credit: Fair-use identification thumbnail via Fandom. Character / franchise art © Herbert estate / Legendary / respective rights holders (as applicable). Not free or redistributable artwork.

entities.name: Kanto
entities.description:
Kanto was born on Ishkal and spent his entire life in slavery. He was placed in the slave pens on Giedi Prime, where Maxim Dubrov made a deal with his owner.

Kanto was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Amado Delsin, Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, the Grey Lady, Poyko Nen and the Morani Twins. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competiton began, he initially avoided contact with his opponents. He later crossed paths with Nen, who was being pursued by the Fremen. As Kanto charged at him, Nen used a hidden mechanism to open trap Kanto in a chamber with venomous rock lizards. As a native of Ishkal, Kanto used his abilities to command the rock lizards.

Kanto later found Nen and the Grey Lady and ordered the lizards to attack. The Grey Lady fled as the lizards tore Nen apart and Kanto attempted to pursue her, but lost her trail. He encountered the Fremen, who killed half of the lizards, causing Kanto to retreat. He was then attacked and killed by the twins.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Kanto was born on Ishkal and spent his entire life in slavery. He was placed in the slave pens on Giedi Prime, where Maxim Dubrov made a deal with his owner.

entities.name: Kanut
entities.description:
Kanut was a character in The Graben Gang.

Kanut was born to a Fremen father. His family were town Fremen who had separated from their sietch brethren several generations previously. He later befriended Juni Dennick, who forced him to attend a festival with her in the hope that he would get out of the depression he had fallen into since the Fremen disappeared.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Kanut was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Keif Villari
entities.description:
Keif Villari was a Dune Men and a presenter on the Communinet Radio.

Keif Villari often gave advice to his fellow Dune Men over the radio to ensure that they could operate safely and make a sizable profit. He would advise them on the importance of keeping their equipment sanitized to ensure that it could be operated to its full capacity.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Keif Villari was a Dune Men and a presenter on the Communinet Radio.

entities.name: Koda O'Garee
entities.description:
Koda O'Garee was the daughter of Phin and Tidjii O'Garee and the sister of Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie and Sally.

Sally O'Garee was born on Arrakis to Phin and Tidjii O'Garee. He had four siblings; Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie and Sally.

Koda and his family were tracking an off-course freighter in the Hagga Basin when their path was blocked by a rock slide. They were then attacked by the Maas Kharet, who accused them of tresspassing on their territory. They attempted to explain that they were just friendly explorers, but the Maas Kharet called them infidels who were defiling the domain of the electric worms. The Maas Kharet prepared to bury them alive, but fled when a Sandworm approached. The O'Garees reached safety on a rock island and once the worm departed, they followed Koda's signal to the Maas Kharet's camp. The O'Garees killed them, took their helmets and Sally found an old map. They then returned to their shop and prepared the helmets for sale.

The O'Garees followed the the map into the Hagga Basin, where they travelled through relentless sandstorms until they reached a testing Station where insects were studied. As they entered, Koda warned Sally that he was picking up a lot of foot traffic and suspected that the station may not have been abandoned. The family hid when a Harkonnen fire team floated down the shaft from above, realising that they had entered a Harkonnen base instead of a testing Station. As they attempted to escape, they encountered a Harkonnen captain, whom Koda and Sally killed in a coordinated attack. Koda took the captain's ear for his collection and offered to help Sally start her own, but she was disgusted by the suggestion. Once they returned to Arrakeen, Phin presented their findings to Alastair Christian Chim and the O'Garees were rewarded by House Atreides, as the base had been causing them problems for some time and Gurney Halleck had been planning to lead an assault on it.
entities.short_description: Koda O'Garee was the daughter of Phin and Tidjii O'Garee and the sister of Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie and Sally.

entities.name: Lanov
entities.description:
Lanov was approached by the Prisoner in Riftwatch. He discussed his enjoyment of Semuta, particularly when the experience was enhanced by Semuta Music. He told them of Maxim Kazmir's excessive use of the drug, stating that he had seen him take a dose strong enough to place a bull in a coma. He stated that they emulated Baron Vladimir Harkonnen in their consumption, for he believed satiation to be the virtue of the weak.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Lazeus
entities.description:
Captain Lazeus was the captain of the Hephaestus.

Lazeus was a respected captain who was known to treat his crew well, including the suboids. He was killed when the Hephaestus crashlanded on Arrakis.

Suph Rondi was approached by the Prisoner on the wreck of the Hephaestus. He told them of Lazeus' popularity and his death in the crash.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Captain Lazeus was the captain of the Hephaestus.

entities.name: Maax
entities.description:
Maax was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Maax was a smuggler based in Carthag who was part of a group led by Stisk that included Valentin, Zoe and Chingo. Valentin poisoned Argus Veer and Maax and Chingo were sent by Stisk to spread the word of his death. They met with the rest of the group afterwards, with Chingo being surprised by how angry the news made the locals. He asked who Veers was, with Maax stating that he had already told him that Veer was the greatest gladiator in 300 years. Maax predicted there would be a full-blown riot within ten minutes.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Maax was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Malek
entities.description:
Captain Malek was the head of the Carryall crew of the Mithra.

Malek was responsible for the course the Mithra took. Once the Harvester crashed in the Hagga Basin, Chief Hanso speculated that Malek had been responsible.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Captain Malek was the head of the Carryall crew of the Mithra.

entities.name: Marcus Amstraad
entities.description:
Captain Marcus Amstraad was a soldier of House Atreides.

Marcus Amstraad was a member of the Fighting Fifth.

Amstraad was interviewed by Redondo Monroe on Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines. He spoke of the troops' operations in the Hagga Basin and their importance in strenghening House Atreides' position in the War of Assassins. Monroe asked him about the heavy losses the Atreides had sustained, which Amstraad stated to be a necessary sacrifice. Mornoe then mentioned previous interviews he had conducted with Sergeants Creel and Aric Thorne, who had discussed the emotional toll that combat had taken on them. He pointed out that many felt that the cost of the war was too high, to which Amstraad replied that the cost of freedom and justice is never too high. Monroe then asked about potential harm to civilians, with Amstraad insisting that Atreides troops prevented this by following the principles of the Great Convention. He also dismissed claims of misconduct by Atreides troops, attributing them to mistakes made under pressure. He finished the interview with a statement assuring the families of Atreides soldiers that their loved ones fought for a just and noble cause.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Captain Marcus Amstraad was a soldier of House Atreides.

entities.name: Marwan Coel
entities.description:
Marwan Coel was a representative of House Maros in the Landsraad.

Marwan Coel was approached by the Prisoner in the deep desert.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Marwan Coel was a representative of House Maros in the Landsraad.

entities.name: Maxim Dubrov
entities.description:
Maxim Dubrov was a slave master and co-host of the The Harkonnen Family Games.

Maxim Dubrov hosted The Harkonnen Family Games alongside Vera Kotilla on the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen. They commentated a confrontation between Poyko Nen and the Grey Lady in the challenge known as the Man Trap. Maxim criticised Poyko's cowardice and mocked the Grey Lady's scarred and disfigured face once her veil was torn off during the fight. Kanto's rock lizards entered the arena and tore Poyko to pieces, which Maxim considered a deserving fate for a coward.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Maxim Dubrov was a slave master and co-host of the The Harkonnen Family Games.

entities.name: Maxim Kazmir
entities.description:
Levenbrech Maxim Kazmir was an intelligence agent of House Atreides.

Maxim Kazmir carried out espionage missions for House Harkonnen in the War of Assassins. During the conflict, he developed a rivalry with Anton Tolliver, an soldier of House Atreides. He was assigned a mission by Duke Leto Atreides in which he was station in The Anvil Tradepost.

Kazmir was approached by Tolliver and informed him that a cousin of his had died. Kazmir's response was nonchalant, outraging Tolliver, who stated that he would be stuck there forever, as even his own Harkonnen masters despised him. They almost attacked each other until Tyg Rolsum and reminded them of the laws of Kanly. Kazmir was then approached by the Prisoner and told them that while Tolliver was a strong combatant, he was not suited to matters of intrigue. He invited them to join House Harkonnen, tasking them with locating an asset of his who had vanished while trailing an Atreides agent. He was uninterested in his own asset and ordered them to bring him all of the information he could gather from the Atreides agent. He then advised them to approach Tolliver and accept his mission, but to bring the findings to him instead.

Once they returned with the information, he informed the Prisoner that the Atreides agent had been a spy training an Atreides deserter, Lieutenant Tighe Skorda. He stated that it was a delicate matter for the Atreides, as Duke Leto Atreides had intervened on Skorda's behalf several years previously, which would cause a scandal if discovered. He offered to help them if they aided him in getting out of the Anvil by getting back into the good graces of House Harkonnen. He then tasked them with planting incriminating evidence of an Atreides fortress.
entities.short_description: Levenbrech Maxim Kazmir was an intelligence agent of House Atreides.

entities.name: Micah
entities.description:
Micah was seven years old when his parents allowed him to listen to an opera about the Battle of Corrin. Discovering that it painted Bashar Abulurd Harkonnen in an unfavourable light. He reported his parents to the Dune Watch network and they were indefinitely detained for spreading propaganda to their child. He was rewarded with an evening watching the gladiator games in Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's private box.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Myr Charki
entities.description:
Myr Charki previously lived on Rossack, but later bartered his way off the planet and left for Arrakis. One night, he offered a patrol of troopers from House Harkonnen a place to sleep one night. When he awoke, they had all left except for one, Ihor. Chakri believed that the Troop Sergeant recognised the value of his establishment and had left Ihor behind to protect the Harkonnen's interests. He made Ihor his silent partner, with him handling the business while Ihor handled the fighting.

Chakri was approached by the Prisoner at the Griffin's Reach Tradepost. He did not recognise them, despite knowing the face of every bandit, scavenger and mercenary from Griffin's Reach to Harko Village. He demanded to know who they were and why Arrakis' airspace was crawling with Sardaukar. They told him that they had arrived on the Proteus and escaped from a Sardaukar. He expressed doubt over their story and answered their questions about Zantara, the Fremen and the conflict between House Atreides and House Harkonnen, the latter of which he was a staunch supporter. He also informed them of the Anvil Tradepost, which he said was run by "Smiley" Tyg Rolsum, and of a nearby Desert Biological Testing Station which was being auditted by the ecologist Derek Chinara.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Nasher Hix
entities.description:
Chief Nasher Hix was a crew member of the Mithra.

Nasher Hix was born into a family that had served the Spice Miner's Guild since the late 9000s, with his mother's side handling supply management and his father's side handling rig technical. Most of his family were killed when House Harkonnen attacked the Windsack Depot. His brother and two remaining cousins died when Carthag was obliterated, leaving him as the only surviving member of their family. He was stationed on the Mithra with Lientenant Drangh and Chief Hanso when it was shot down in Hagga Basin.

Hix was approached by the Prisoner and told them that the ship's medic was dead that the entirety of the Harvester's Med Bay side had been sheared off. He informed them that he was doing what little he could to treat the wounded and would need their help in order to stabilize them. The Prisoner returned with enough medical equipment to treat them, with Tolverson and Cheng in vital need of treatment. He then tasked them with arming the crew to defend them from attackers, for which they provided improvised Maula pistols. He informed them that the Kirab had entered the wreck and were preparing to attack them from all sides, which he urged them to prevent. They returned and he thanked them for dispatching with the Kirab. He revealed that Drangh had contacted Central Dispatch and the crew were now waiting to be rescued.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Chief Nasher Hix was a crew member of the Mithra.

entities.name: Norrin
entities.description:
Turgun Hauer planned to use Norrin as a scapegoat once his actions had attracted too much attention, knowing that Norrin would gladly give his life if he believed it would help their cause. Hauer's recording of this plan was later found by the Prisoner at Imperial Testing Station No. 142.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Osten Laithe
entities.description:
Osten Laithe was an engineer in the Imperial Planetologist's Office.

Osten Laithe worked in the Imperial Planetologist's Office, where he became acquainted with Hester Klimt and made her his assistant. He was seduced by Phaedra Vye, to whom he told his deepest secrets. She asked him for asked him to for money to buy back her family's heirlooms from House Harkonnen.

Laithe's corpse was discovered in his private room at The Salusan Bull. The Prisoner investigated the scene after being granted entry by Ugo Firenze and then questioned Klimt.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
Pennethorne Larkspur was a representative of House Wydras in the Landsraad.

Pennethorne Larkspur was approached by the Prisoner to the north of the Edge of Acheron.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Pennethorne Larkspur was a representative of House Wydras in the Landsraad.

entities.name: Petrum
entities.description:
Petrum was served by Kaylen Shiff until she killed him, for which she was placed in the slave pens on Giedi Prime.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Petrum was served by Kaylen Shiff until she killed him, for which she was placed in the slave pens on Giedi Prime.

entities.name: Petyr
entities.description:
Petyr was tasked by Elara Tuek to infiltrate the slaves in Khidr's Shadow.

Petyr was approached by the Prisoner in his cell. Deducing that they were the person he had been waiting for, he gave thanks to Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV and told them to tell Elara that he could no longer do that kind of work. He informed them that he had heard about a special cadre of slaves being kept for a special leader, the Glutton. He was horrified upon seeing him, as he was a cannibal who would eat his victims while they were still alive. The Prisoner asked for the key to the Glutton's dining room and Petyr handed it over, but warned them not to go down there.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Phin O'Garee
entities.description:
Phin O'Garee was born into a tomb robbing family on Hagal. As a child, he met Tidjii. Phin's father, who had not conducted the necessary research beforehard, led them in an attempted robbery of a tomb that belonged to a formidable family. Now being hunted, Phin and Tidjii travelled to the furthest planet they could afford to travel to, Arrakis. They later married and had five children; Phin Jr., Phaedra, Brie, Sally and Koda.

Tidjii was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in Arrakeen. He declared that if they needed something, O'Garee's Imports had it, and would get it if they did not.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Phin O'Garee Jr.
entities.description:
Phin O'Garee Jr. was the son of Phin and Tidjii O'Garee and the brother of Phaedra, Brie, Sally and Koda.

Phin O'Garee Jr. was born on Arrakis to Phin and Tidjii O'Garee. He had four siblings; Phaedra, Brie, Sally and Koda.

Phin and his family were tracking an off-course freighter in the Hagga Basin when their path was blocked by a rock slide. They were then attacked by the Maas Kharet, who accused them of tresspassing on their territory. They attempted to explain that they were just friendly explorers, but the Maas Kharet called them infidels who were defiling the domain of the electric worms. The Maas Kharet prepared to bury them alive, but fled when a Sandworm approached. The O'Garees reached safety on a rock island and once the worm departed, they followed Koda's signal to the Maas Kharet's camp. The O'Garees killed them, took their helmets and Sally found an old map. They then returned to their shop and prepared the helmets for sale.

The O'Garees followed the the map into the Hagga Basin, where they travelled through relentless sandstorms until they reached a testing station where insects were studied. The family hid when a Harkonnen fire team floated down the shaft from above, realising that they had entered a Harkonnen base instead of a testing station. As they attempted to escape, they encountered a Harkonnen captain, whom Sally and Koda killed in a coordinated attack. Once they returned to Arrakeen, Phin presented their findings to Alastair Christian Chim and the O'Garees were rewarded by House Atreides, as the base had been causing them problems for some time and Gurney Halleck had been planning to lead an assault on it.
entities.short_description: Phin O'Garee Jr. was the son of Phin and Tidjii O'Garee and the brother of Phaedra, Brie, Sally and Koda.

entities.name: Pollux
entities.description:
Pollux was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Pollux was present with Argus Veer at the Carthag ampitheater. As they observed a reenactment of the Battle of Windsack, with Veer asking why the Harkonnens celebrated it if they lost it. Pollux replied that there were disagreements on how the battle concluded and how was responsible for the destruction of a Spice Miners' Guild facility situated there. Growing irritated, Veer demanded to know why his Spice had not been delivered. They were surprised when it was not Vastari who arrived, but Valentin, who had been sent in his stead. Veer consumed the Spice, not caring for Pollux's question of whether the servant had delivered his success, causing him to calm down and fall asleep.

Pollux explained to Valentin that while they were mostly retired, they came when called by Baron Vladimir Harkonnen, as Veer's vanity would not allow him to refuse. He then stated that due to the many injuries that Veer had suffered over the years, leaving him in constant pain and beyond even the help of the Bene Tleilax. He elaborated that the pain would drive most men to take their own lives, but Veer was too vain to willingly die.

Vastari later arrived, causing Pollux to ask him what had happened to Valentin. Vastari was not familiar with the name, apologising for his lateness and explaining the reason for it. Realizing that Veer had been poisoned, Pollux found him dead.
entities.short_description: Pollux was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Portifoy
entities.description:
Portifoy was the bodyguard of Cyprian Io.

Portifoy was a member of a gang of kidnapped by a gang of Opeeachean thugs who captured Cyprian Io. Io negotiated with Portifoy and convinced him to betray the others and return him to his home. Portifoy was rewarded by being appointed as Cyprian's bodyguard.

Portifoy stood guard by Io when he was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. Io ordered Portifoy to remove them from his sight, but rescinded the order when he considered the lecture that his grandmother, Orilis Io, would give him.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Portifoy was the bodyguard of Cyprian Io.

entities.name: Poyko Nen
entities.description:
Poyko Nen was a Captain of the Guard in the service of House Harkonnen.

Poyko Nen served House Harkonnen as a Captain of the Guard. He was in command when House Atreides carried out a suicide raid, destroying valuable resources. Nen was hated by many due to his failure to stop the Atreides and was placed in the slave pens on Giedi Prime as punishment.

Nen was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Amado Delsin, Hollow Tom, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, the Grey Lady, the Morani Twins and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition began, he struggled in the Web of Deception. He managed to escape, though he barely survived the effort. He was pursued by the Fremen when he and Shiff reached the Abyssal Chamber, where they circled each other over the bottomless pit. She fired at his with her needle gun, but he deflected them with his makeshift shield and retaliated with a swift strike from his dagger. The brutal showdown continued until he threw his weight against her and sent her falling into the pit.

Gravely wounded, Nen was almost attacked by the Fremen until the twins scaled the walls and cut off his path. Using the opportunity to escape, the crowd were displeased by Nen's cowardice. The Fremen continued to pursue him upon overcoming the twins until Nen reached the path of Kanto. As Kanto charged at him, Nen used a hidden mechanism to open a wall and trap Kanto in a chamber filled with venomous rock lizards. He later encountered the Grey Lady and attacked her. She was surprisingly strong and fast, but he managed to tear off her veil, revealing her scarred and disfigured face. Kanto arrived and ordered the rock lizards to attack. The Grey Lady fled as the rock lizards overpowered Nen and tore him apart.
entities.short_description: Poyko Nen was a Captain of the Guard in the service of House Harkonnen.

entities.name: Raif Oslow
entities.description:
Raif Oslow was a soldier of House Atreides.

Raif Oslow was born on Caladan. He became a street thug and was eventually sentenced to serve on a prison planet for his crimes. He was saved from this fate when Tighe Skorda of the Constabulary intervened. Skorda saw something in Oslow and covered up his crimes, recruiting him into the House Forces of House Atreides.

Oslow was approached by the Prisoner in Arrakeen. They asked him about Skorda's whereabouts and he told them of how Skorda recruited him. He then told them that he had last seen Skorda speaking to a recruiter from the Maas Kharet.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Raif Oslow was a soldier of House Atreides.

entities.name: Rashad
entities.description:
Rashad was a character in The Graben Gang.

Rashad won the Golden Hat at the Spice Cake competition every year. One year, gave out free samples at his booth, which attracted a long line. Despite the popularity of his entry, Duv Dennick was announced as the winner. However, once the judge learned that the secret ingredient provided by Franklin Munt caused anyone who consumed it to belch profusely, Duv was disqualified.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Rashad was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Redondo Monroe
entities.description:
Redondo Monroe was the host of Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines.

Redondo Monroe hosted Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines on the Communinet Radio station of House Atreides, in which he interviewed soldiers who had fought for the house. He interviewed Sgt. Creel about his experiences during an operation at Dejum Wati, in which seven Atreides cohorts attacked a bastion of House Harkonnen. Despite Monroe's attempts to make it sound like a glorious tale of heroism, Creel spoke in great detail of how traumatising and disillusioning the experience had been despite their victory. Monroe tried to steer the conversation in a more positive direction by asking him about moments of hope and comradery, but Creel replied that they were fleeting between the horrifying experiences.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Redondo Monroe was the host of Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines.

entities.name: Riko Marr
entities.description:
Riko Marr was a character in Death on the Titan.

Riko Marr was a deckhard on the Sand Titan. He had an antagonistic relationship with Chief Jarrick Thorne and was questioned by Captain Andohar Noah after Thorne died under suspiscious circumstances after a heated argument between them. Noah told Riko that he had searched his locker and discovered a coded message from the intelligence division of House Atreides that was addressed to Thorne. Riko insisted that he knew nothing of the message and was being framed, despite Noah's warning that the Spice Miner's Guild would allow the crew to kill him to satisfy their desire for revenge over Thorne's death.

However, another crew member came forward and stated that he had seen Riko enter the shigawire hut on the night of Thorne's murder. Riko then admitted to taking the message, but denied killing Thorne. Noah demanded to know why Riko had taken the message and he replied that he had hoped it contained incriminating information about Thorne. Noah ordered Riko to place his hand flat on the table, plunging a knife into it once he did. Overcome with pain, Riko confessed to the murder, stating that Tessa Lim had put him up to it.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Riko Marr was a character in Death on the Titan.

entities.name: Rix
entities.description:
Inspector Rix was a character in The Graben Gang.

Rix was appointed as security inspector to Depot 12 after the previous inspector had to spend three weeks in a tranquility pod. Upon his arrival, he informed Duv Dennick and Franklin Munt that he was there to conduct a thorough inspection of the security initiatives, which he found to be among the worst in the Imperial Basin. Duv stated that the Kirab were to blame for this, to which Rix replied that he would decide who would be blamed. Rix was bewildered when Frank activated Gary, his newly-constructed sentry automaton. However, Rix was killed when the machine mistook them for intruders and attacked.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Inspector Rix was a character in The Graben Gang.

entities.name: Rodrigo
entities.description:
Rodrigo was a character in The Swordsman.

Rodrigo was a draftsman in the Imperial Engineering Guild and later helped to build a colony on Amarynth III. The village was later taken over by the slave Varek, who imprisoned Rodrigo and his daughter Gina in a dungeon. One day, a stranger calling himself the Swordsman fell into the dungeon. Rodrigo and Gina helped him recover and revealed a secret exit that Rodrigo had built for the previous governor. Upon escaping, the Swordsman forged a new sword and inspired the villagers to rise in revolt against Varek. Varek and his followers were defeated, though Rodrigo was killed in the conflict.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Rodrigo was a character in The Swordsman.

entities.name: Seron Varlin
entities.description:
Seron Varlin trained as a swordmaster in the Ginaz School. He later lost his sight.

Varlin was approached by the Prisoner in Harko Village. He warned them to keep their distance, though he was past his prime he could still thrash them. They assured them that they meant him no harm and informed them that he scribed the word "regret" into the flesh of several individuals who attempted to toss him into the Deep desert to be eaten by a Sandworm. They asked him to train them in the ways of the Ginaz Swordmasters.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Seron Varlin trained as a swordmaster in the Ginaz School. He later lost his sight.

entities.name: Soha Sirrendrin
entities.description:
Soha Sirrendrin was approached by the Prisoner at his stall in in Arrakeen. They asked if he ran a CHOAM vendor and he replied that he did before asking if it was a test by the Committee on Interstellar Traffic and Trade or if Lady Nevaldine had put them up to it. They replied that it was not a test and he assured them that everything was in order. He told them that CHOAM's technology was the key to mastering their environment and explained how their various products worked.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Starky
entities.description:
Starky was approached by the Prisoner at a fortress of House Harkonnen in Hagga Rift. He told them to leave until they called him "Starky", which alarmed him as only other members of the Mobula Gang knew him by that name. The Prisoner relied that the rest of the gang had sold him out. He was angered and declared that he was done with the gang and that things had turned sideways since they had started associating with slavers. He agreed to give them the coordinated for a slaver base in which the gang had made a deal.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Suph Rondi
entities.description:
Suph Rondi was a crewman of the Hephaestus.

Suph Rondi was on his third voyage on the Hephaestus. The suboids went insane, causing Captain Lazeus to seal off the bridge and warn the crew to get to safety. The suboids got into the engines and caused the ship to crash-land on Arrakis, turning the lights out. Hearing screams in the darkness, Rondi hid in a secluded area and waited for a rescue.

Rondi was found by the Prisoner. He told them what had caused the ship to crash and they asked them how they could reach the crago hold. He replied that there was an eye scanner attached to the pentashield, but refused to leave his hiding place due to his fear of the suboids. They asked if there was another way to enter the cargo hold and he told them that Jackson and Addison both had authorization.

entities.name: Tamzin Flaxenraad
entities.description:
Tamzin Flaxenraad was an Imperial Treasurer.

Tamzin Flaxenraad was born on Alpha Hydrae, the fifth son of Graf Heino Flaxenraad. Due to how far he was in the line of succession, he was devalued and could hope for no better honor than a position in finance or the House Guard. He became the Imperial Treasurer in Arrakeen, where it was his duty to recieve, count and convey the right and proper incomes of the Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV.

Tamzin Flaxenraad was approached by the Prisoner at the Imperial Consulate in Arrakeen. He explained to them his background and his responsibilities, all while complaining about being in a position he saw as beneath him.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Taron
entities.description:
Taron was a character in The Young Guardians.

Taron was the son of a farmer. He attended the War Gym at Cala City where he trained to join the House Guard of Duke Leto Atreides alongside his friends Lyra and Eamon. They were antagonised by a group of cadets led by Aiden, who constantly insulted them. They were assigned to the Peak of Valor challenge, a two-day endurance test to plant their flag at the summit of Mount Syubi. As they neared the summit, Lyra fell to a ledge below and told Taron and Eamon to leave her behind, but they refused and rescued her. Aiden's group reached the summit first and planted their flag, but despite their loss Taron and his friends felt pride in doing the right thing.

Taron and Lyra entered the lecture hall the day before their graduation to return a borrowed tome. They discovered a light on in the commandant's office, despite having just seen him on the green. Investigating, they found Aiden stealing the commandant's code book. They informed Eamon, who remembered his older brother telling him of an infiltrator from House Harkonnen in their class. Concluding that Aiden was the infiltrator, they informed the commandant, who had Aiden and his group arrested for espionage and treason during the graduation ceremony. As it was wartime, the commandant invoked kanly and killed Aiden and his group be slashing their throats. He them commended the graduates, declaring them the future of House Atreides. Taron, Lyra and Eamon were then assigned to Arrakis.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Taron was a character in The Young Guardians.

entities.name: The Guide
entities.description:
The Guide was a mysterious individual who appeared to the Prisoner in dreams induced by the Spice Melange.

The Guide first called out to the Prisoner in a dream caused by exposure to the Spice Melange shortly after their arrival on Arrakis. He told them of the Trials of Aql, which they would need to complete to prove the knowledge of the ways of the Fremen.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: The Swordsman
entities.description:
The Swordsman was the titular character of the radio play.

The Swordsman was a lone warrior who wandered the Known Universe fighting for truth and justice. He travelled to Amarynth III after defeating Hyrenzir on the plains of Jericha. He learned from a young boy that his village was enslaved by Lord Varek due to the fall of House Wayku and the abandonment of the planet by the Spacing Guild. The Swordsman confronted Varek, whose guards attacked and manouvered him onto a trapdoor. In the pit, he met Rodrigo and his daughter Gina, who helped him escape. He forged a new sword and trained the villagers, inspiring them to rise in revolt against Varek. The Swordsman killed Varek and the villagers defeated his followers, but Rodrigo was killed. The Swordsman assured Gina that her father did not die in vain and instructed her to help the villagers endure until the Spacing Guild returned for them before departing.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: The Swordsman was the titular character of the radio play.

entities.name: The Vulture
entities.description:
The Vulture was a town Fremen who married a sietch Fremen named Felicity. She was killed in an attack by the Sardaukar while attempting to defend children. Losing her broke him and he continued to speak to her as if she were alive.

The Vulture was approached by the Prisoner in an abandoned alleyway in Arrakeen. He introduced them to Felicity, apologising for her silence. They pointed out that there was nobody there and he replied that it hurt Felicity's feelings. Angered by their rudeness, he told them to state their business or leave. They told him that they were seeking the Jackal and he told them that he would only speak to those who knew the words. He told them that Felicity knew the word and he presented a riddle on her behalf. They correctly answered that the word was "silence", for which he commended them. He told them that it was an old Fremen riddle that she had learned when she lived among them. The Prisoner asked if Felicity knew what happened to the Fremen and he told her of how she was killed. He admitted that he knew it was insane, but found solace in keeping the one he loved. He told them that the word they were looking for was "worm".

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
The Wolf was approached by the Prisoner in an abandoned alleyway in Arrakis. They told him that they were seeking the Jackal, to which he replied that the Jackal would not speak to anyone unless he requested it. He asked if they knew the word required to make this request and they admitted that they did not. He gave them a chance to guess the word. He presented a riddle to them and they correctly answered that the word was "seek" He commended them and promised that if they could find the other words, the Jackal would speak with them.

entities.name: Theophilus
entities.description:
Theophilus was the butler of the Janusian Faithful.

Theophilus travelled to Arrakis alongside the Janusian Faithful, which included Phaedra Vye, Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Roella Ramsby, Oona Byrn, Venesir Ask, Bianca Bagetti, Eulalia Harthorn, Hesperia Farani and Ansel Virro. He served the group at their secretive gatherings.

Theophilus was on duty at a banquet attended by Harthorn, Virro, Yimari, Ramsby, Byrn and Bagetti, during which several of the nobles present died from drinking poisoned wine. He was approached by the Prisoner and advised them to talk to Harthorn, who still drew breath. They later returned and asked him why there had been a placement change for Yimari, to which he replied that she had been alergic to a species of planet in the flower arrangement. They asked about the seating plan, but he stated that it had been destroyed by wine spilled by a drunken noble. They later asked him of a note that he had passed to Ramsby on behalf of Ambrose Lucifera, for whom he expressed his dislike.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Tighe Skorda
entities.description:
Captain Tighe Skorda was a soldier of House Atreides.

Tighe Skorda was found by the Prisoner in Hagga Basin. Near death, he declared that he would tell them anything they wished to know. They asked him what the bad spice was and he replied that he did not know, as they had found it on Ix and did not know how dangerous it was until the Kytheria crashlanded on Arrakis. The crew then began dying and he abandoned them to recover one of the containers, which he sold to the Sandflies. He was then pursued by mercenaries and evaded them. He then joined the Maas Kharet and went into hiding. Once he got sick, Nahla and Jorba turned on him and he fled. He told the Prisoner that it did not matter which of the Great Houses won the War of Assassins, as everyone else would suffer. The Prisoner then left him to die.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

Tolliver Cam would give messages of hope to his listeners and introduce programmes such as The Wastelander Chronicles, Through Their Eyes: Firsthand Accounts from the Frontlines, The Young Guardians and The Swordsman.

entities.name: Tom
entities.description:
Tom was a large man who became known as "Hollow Tom" due to his eating habits, as many believed his legs must have been hollow in order to support his weight. He was placed in the slave pens on Giedi Prime after an altercation with a distant cousin of Baron Vladimir Harkonnen.

Tom was later chosen to compete in the Harkonnen Family Games alongside Amado Delsin, Kaylen Shiff, an unnamed Fremen, the Grey Lady, Poyko Nen, the Morani Twins and Kanto. They were placed in the Grand Arena, which had been made into a labyrinth. Once the competition began, he entered the Cavern of the Shrieking Moss, where he triggered an explosive trap. He was wounded, but continued moving. He crossed paths with Delsin and a fierce showdown occured between them, which ended with Delsin slicing Tom open and causing his guts to spill out.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Tors
entities.description:
Sub-Prefect Tors was an official of the Imperium.

Tors was sent to interrogate the Prisoner after they were arrested for being spotted with Zantara's cielago, Noctua. Accompanied by Sardaukar, he entered the cell and was eager to deal with it quickly, as he had a transport due to arrive soon. He ordered Arsen Demo, Vitor Azat and another prisoner to leave. He approached the Prisoner and was disturbed that he did not know them, as it was his job to know everyone in Harko Village, which made him look bad in front of his superior. He told them that they had been seen fleeing the wreck of the Proteus, where the bodies of all the occupants had been accounted for. He demanded to know their identity and their connection to Zantara.

As he had no time to continue the interrogation, Tors ordered the Sardaukar to kill the Prisoner. Count Hasimir Fenring entered the cell and stated that he did not intend to slight Tors, he believed the interrogation would benefit from his own visage. Fenring then removed his mask and the Prisoner stole a Sardaukar blade, attempting to stab themself. Tors knocked the blade out of their hand, after which they began to beat themself. Fenring explained to Tors that it was hypno-ligation, which conditioned the Prisoner to kill themself upon seeing his face. Fenring then put his mask back on and ordered that the Prisoner be taken from the cell.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
Traj Axxari was approached by the Prisoner in Pinnacle Station. He explained to them that the slavers plaguing the hills surrounding the station were protected by Imperial sanction. He eleborated that Arrakis had three commodoties: Spice, water and manpower, the third of what House Harkonnen were severely lacking. He warned them that they would have a hard time avoiding slavers, as they were widespread in the area. He also stated that he only dealt with people who respected the deal and that Gloos Bohannon would shoot anyone who did not.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening

Tripp Yates was approached by the Prisoner at Helius Gate. They asked him what the Sandflies had tasked him to recover from the wreck of the Kytherea. He replied that it was only medical supplies, but when pressed he admitted that he did not know what was in the cargo. He revealed that an individual known as the Red Scorpion had ordered the Sandlies to send him to transport the cargo with discretion. He then told them that it was rumored that the cargo was being sought by crime lords, spies and Imperials and that the Red Scorpion could be found at an old testing station.

He was later tracked down by the Prisoner at his base, Imperial Testing Station No. 142. He and his allies put up a fight, but were ultimately killed by the Prisoner.

entities.name: Ufim
entities.description:
Ufim was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Ufim was a pyon who served House Harkonnen in Carthag. His cousin had disappeared, having been said to be an agitator, to none could say what he did.

As he prepared to test a long throw cutteray auger with an ungraded barrel, he warned Dayvan of the potential dangers of doing so. Dayvan agreed, but pointed out that they had direct orders from Piter de Vries. Once everything was set up, they activated the cutteray, only for it to go out of phase, vaporize the beam splitter and empty the charge onto Areg, killing him. Horrified by what they had witnessed, the rest of the pyons were ordered to continue their shifts.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
Ugo Firenze was the assistant manager of The Salusan Bull.

Ugo Firenze grew up in a vineyard and fought for House Atreides in offworld wars such as the Liberation of Ix (in which his brother Enzo was killed), the raid on Giedi Prime and the Arrakis campaign. He later travelled to Arrakis alongside his Duke Leto Atreides and became the assistant manager of The Salusan Bull.

Firenze was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull. He outlined his military history and his duties such as handling security operations and performing as the wine steward.

entities.name: Valentin
entities.description:
Valentin was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Valentin was a smuggler based in Carthag who was part of a group with led by Stisk, which also included Zoe, Chingo and Maax. He entered the Carthag ampitheater and delivered poisoned Spice to the legendary gladiator Argus Veer, whom he had idolised since he was a child. As he travelled through the main concourse, he saw twenty metre holograms of himself and his fellow smugglers. He met with Zoe and Stisk and informed them that alerts seeking them were broadcast on the Communinet Radio stations of both House Harkonnen and the Imperium. Stisk stated that she had it covered, which Valentin dismissed as "bullshit". Stisk insisted that they would escape in ten minutes as the authorities would be to distracted to hunt them, as the crowd would revolt upon learning of Veer's death. Chingo and Maax arrived and informed the others that they had spread the word about Veer's death. Stisk then revealed that she had blown their cover by falsely reporting all of the alcohol in the vault they had hit in Tsimpo as destroyed. Zoe and Valentin were angered that Stisk had made it so they could never return to their homes, as she was willing to sabotage her own people due to her vendetta against the Harkonnens.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Valentin was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

entities.name: Varek
entities.description:
Varek was born a slave, but took control of a village on Amarynth III when it became clear that the planet had been abandoned by the Spacing Guild. One day, a stranger who introduced himself as the Swordsman arrived in the village and announced his intention to kill Varek. Varek ordered his guards to seize the intruder. Advised that the stranger fought like the Ginaz Swordmasters of legend, Varek had his guards manouver him onto a trapdoor, causing him to fall into the trap. However, the Swordsman escaped and led the villagers in a revolt, during which he killed Varek in single combat.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.name: Varric
entities.description:
Varric was a tracker who served Lord Havoc.

Varric was sent to Draconis IV, where he spent weeks mapping miles of treacherous tunnels in an attempt to locate a Draconian burrower. Upon the arrival of Lord Havoc, Varric alerted him to fresh claw marks that had been detected on the walls, stating it to be a sign that they were approaching the creature's latest burrow. On Havoc's orders, Varric prepared the containment fields to capture the creature. However, it fought back as they attempted to detain it, causing the tunnels to destabilise. Varric warned Havoc that they must leave before the tunnels collapsed, but Havoc was insistent on capturing the creature at any cost. The creature escaped and Havoc punished Varric for his failure by leaving him in the tunnels to die as he pleaded for his life.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening
entities.short_description: Varric was a tracker who served Lord Havoc.

entities.name: Vastari
entities.description:
Vastari was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Vastari was employed in the Carthag ampitheater on the day that Argus Veer was due to fight. He was assigned to deliver some Spice to Veer, but was delayed due to how busy it was in the upper parts of the ampitheater. Once he arrived in Veer's quarters, his page Pollux asked him what had happened to Valentin. Vastari was unfamiliar with the name, but apologised and explained the reason for his lateness. Finding Veer unconscious, Vastari suggested waking him with a bucket of water, only for Pollux to inform him that Veer was dead.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
Vitor Azat was imprisoned in Harko Village when the cell he was placed in was visited by Sub-Prefect Tors, who ordered Azat, Arsen Demo and another prisoner to leave while the fourth prisoner remained behind.

entities.name: Zantara
entities.description:
Bronso Vernius was a nobleman of House Vernius. He travelled to Arrakis and allied with the Fremen, becoming known as Zantara the Lion.

Zantara was tasked with searching for Alnaëm by Stilgar after his disappearance.

Zantara lead attacks on the Harkonnens during the War of Assassins. He destroyed the last phased iron refinery in the Northern Precinct of Carthag and the last facility that produced and tested Las-Barrels. He saved The Prisoner from a wreckage and sealed them in a cave to keep them safe while they recovered, reminding the offworlder that they owed him their life. The Prisoner can choose to be guided by Zantara or go by themselves. If they choose to follow Zantara, he will instruct on the process of building a Maula pistol. Later, The Prisoner is asked by a villager in Harko Village to kill Zantara and bring them his head. The Prisoner can choose to go through with it, or leave him alive.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening Awakening

entities.description:
Zayn De Witte was a twisted mentat who previously served House Harkonnen.

Zayn De Witte served House Harkonnen as a twisted mentat. He later deserted due to a falling out with Piter de Vries and began to apply his skills in the underworld.

De Witte was approached by the Prisoner in The Salusan Bull in Arrakeen. He told them of his desertion from House Harkonnen and offered to train them in the ways of the mentat. He told them that he would train them if they got rid of the Mobula Gang, who were regularly disrupting his operations.

He thoroughly enjoyed Bach's work and believed there to have been only three musicians as talented as he. He thought Licallo was on-par, but not better.

entities.name: Bannerjee
entities.description:
Bannerjee was a Security Officer of Emperor Paul Atreides. He was one of who came up through the Fremen Constabulary, winning his place on brains and proven loyalty despite the smuggler ancestry attested by his name. Both Chani and Stilgar trusted him. Abumojandis served as his aide.

Bannerjee was a solid figure, almost fat. Wisps of black hair fell down over the dark, wet-appearing skin of his forehead like the crest of an exotic bird. His eyes were blue-blue and steady in a gaze which could look upon happiness or atrocity without change of expression.

In a deleted scene from Dune Messiah, Abumojandis is present with Abumojandis and Paul Atreides using a distrans recorder to extract the names of the conspirators from Bijaz. Upon being named as a traitor, Abumojandis attempts to assassinate Paul with a cutterray, but Bannerjee sacrifices himself stepping in the way of his cutterray while Paul himself hurls a knife, killing his aide. Bannerjee is grievously injured, but survives the attack.

entities.name: Basil I Yusuf
entities.description:
Emperor BasiI I Yusuf was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 2238–2249 AG), succeeding his father Shahrukh Kenric I as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

entities.name: Bolig Avati
entities.description:
Bolig Avati was the Lead Administator of the Ixian Technocrat Council. He, and the other members of the Technocrat Council, conspired against Earl Rhombur Vernius, so the Council could wretch control of the planet from the Royal Family.

Bolig Avati and the other Ixian advisors repeatedly tried to assassinate Earl Rhombur Vernius, the ruler of the Royal Family of Ix, by staging accidents, so the Technocrat Council of Ix could rule the planet.

Bolig Avati attended a meeting at the Landsraad Hall of Oratory, with other representatives of factions chosen by the newly elected Padishah Emperor Paul Atreides. Durinng the meeting, Paul proposed an alliance between the Atreides Empire and the factions, in which the Imperium would protect their holdings. Avati asked Paul whether they would have to worship Paul, should they agree to their alliance. More factions than Paul initially believed were hesitant toward an alliance with the Atreides and the meeting ended without a contract signed.

When Earl Rhombur Vernius of Ix survived an assassination attempt, albeit damaged, the Ixian advisors consistently bothered Vernius, threatening to disrupt his rule. In a fit of anger, the cybernetically enhanced Vernius struck Avati, sending him flying across the room. His fellow advisers helped him up and retreated to the House frigate.

entities.name: Corrin IV
entities.description:
Emperor Corrin IV was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1701–1735 AG), the first to rule since the death of Henoor III in 1604, nearly a century prior.

Prior to his accession, Corrin IV was known as Prince Corrin bin Alman bin Henoor; he was thus the son of an Alman and the grandson of an Henoor. Corrin's family were distant heirs of House Corrino, descending from Emperor Corrin II (who ruled more than a millennium earlier, in 477–482).

After the death of the previous Corrino emperor, Henoor III, without immediate heirs in 1604, the government of the Imperium was placed under a Landsraad-led Regency to sort out various claims to the imperial throne. The Regency collapsed in 1680, when regents Maria I Mustami and (two weeks later) Damiano Fulgencio resigned due to large amounts of unrest in the Imperium. This unrest was artificially stimulated through weapon sales by Iraklii Harkonnen. After 1680, the only Imperium-wide government was a loosely organized committee of different Houses Major. Iraklii eventually rooted out Prince Corrin and promoted his accession to the throne as a solution to the Imperium's ills. The Houses Major saw this hope in the midst of the chaos as an almost divine solution and thus elected the prince as Corrin IV in 1701.

Corrin IV established a new ruling branch of House Corrino upon his accession, the First House of Corrin Corrino. One of Corrin's first acts as emperor was to reward Iraklii Harkonnen. The emperor introduced House Harkonnen as a House Major and named Iraklii as Baron Saugus, in the Colton Sector. Corrin pressed the Landsraad to confirm his actions. The Landsraad confirmed the promotions of House Harkonnen in 1717.

entities.name: Corrin V
entities.description:
Emperor Corrin V reigned as Emperor of the Known Universe nine times between 1846 AG and 1969 AG, during the Era of the Princes.

Corrin's brief reigns and frequent depositions and restorations were the result of the machinations of House Atreides, economically dominant in this period. Phillipos III Atreides and Markos Atreides forced a rapid turnover of emperors, seeking to prevent any one dynast from achieving too much power.

Corrin first became emperor in 1846, succeeding his uncle Irulon I. He ruled for only two years before being deposed in favor of his second cousin, Sidir VI, in 1848. Sidir ruled until 1862, when Corrin was restored to the throne. This second reign lasted until 1877, when Sidir was restored and ruled until 1882, when Corrin was restored for a second time. Corrin's third reign lasted only until 1884, when he was deposed in favor of his cousin Ezhar III. Corrin was restored for a fourth reign in 1897, succeeding his cousin Audrii III, but was deposed in the same year in favor of his own son, Corrin VI. Corrin VI was deposed in 1908 and Corrin V was restored for a fifth reign, ruling until 1919 when he was deposed in favor of his other son, Corrin VII.

Corrin V was restored to the throne for a sixth reign in 1935, again succeeding Corrin VI, and ruled until 1937, when he was deposed in favor of Audrii III. Audrii then ruled until 1938, when Corrin V was restored. He then ruled until 1940, when he was deposed in favor of Costin III, a grandson of Irulon I. In 1955, Corrin V was restored to the throne yet again, succeeding Sidir VII (a son of Sidir VI) and ruled until 1956 when he was replaced with Sidir VII's brother Negara III. Corrin V's ninth and final reign began in 1965, when he again succeeded Sidir VI on the throne. He ruled until 1969, when he was succeeded again by Audrii III.

entities.description:
Imperial Overseer of Spice Operations|loyalty=Venport Holdings (Josef Venport) House Corrino (Roderick Corrino)|education=Order of Mentats|eyes=dark|hair=long, jet-black}}

Draigo Roget was a student of the early mentat school, which was established by Gilbertus Albans on the planet Lampadas after the Battle of Corrin. Gilbertus considered Draigo to be his finest student, not knowing that he had been recruited by Josef Venport to learn the ways of the mentat for the purposes of advancing Venport Holdings.

Draigo Roget is a student of the original Mentat School, also served as a teaching assistant. He paid for his considerable tuition with a gift from an unnamed benefactor (actually Josef Venport), and nearly finished with everything the Mentat School could teach him in just five years. He was arguably the best student the school had ever had. Gilbertus had never met anyone quite so brilliant.

When Draigo was about to graduate with the highest honors in the history of the school, Gilbertus asked him to consider remaining on Lampadas as an instructor, but Draigo was noncommittal. At that time, Draigo was able to won nearly forty percent of the engagements in war-game against Gilbertus.

entities.name: Edrik
entities.description:
Edrik [d. 15263 AG] was a Spacing Guild Navigator, one of the Edrics, who assumed the role of leadership over his fellow Steersman as the time of Kralizec came to fruition.

As Murbella cemented her grip over the flow of Spice, the Guild found itself increasingly desperate to the near blackmail that the New Sisterhood held over melange. Murbella wanted the Guild to ferry raw materials and workers to the shipyards of Richese and Ix at a discounted rate, and would only give the Guild enough melange for their basic services and needs.

Edrik and the Guild's Chief Administrator Rental Gorus paid a visit to Chapterhouse to convince Murbella increase their spice allotment. With the counsel of Bellonda and Doria, Murbella chose to show the Guild a "tough line", much to Edrik's dismay. This caused Edrik to seek the influence of the Guild's guiding patron saint and founder, the Oracle of Time/Norma Cenva. Upon communing with the Oracle, Edrik was warned that his over-concern for spice was not paramount, as the beginning of the "battle of battles" was about to begin.

Out of the rubble came the final Ghola incarnation of Tylwyth Waff, whom Edrik had ordered incarnated years earlier. It was hoped that the reborn Tleilaxu Master would remember the secret of producing melange in an Axlotl Tank. Waff could not remember that process, but upon meeting Edrik safely aboard his heighliner in the Thalim system, Waff told Edrik he could produce a new variance of worm that would be water resistant.

In 207 AG, Elrood II was restored to the throne with the aid of Thomas Atreides, deposing the Alman Corrino emperor Estil I. Elrood rewarded Atreides by granting him the Dukedom of Jaddua and a planetary fiefdom. Elrood ruled until 236 AG, when he was succeeded by his cousin Rugo I Saluso II.

entities.name: Estil II
entities.description:
Padishah Emperor Estil II (d. 1099) was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1051–1099 AG), succeeding his father, the usurper Feyd I, as ruler of the Imperium.

Unlike his father, Estil was a weak and indecisive man, though not without intelligence. Resistance against the rule of the House of Feyd had by the time of Estil's accession evolved into a full Civil War. By 1027, it had reached a stalemate, with the Feyd forces controlling the main trading worlds, the rebels (including some noble houses, most notably House Atreides, and the Sardaukar) controlling the outer colonies, and the Spacing Guild selling transport to both sides.

In 1096, Odusseus Atreides managed to conduct a surprise raid on Ibleam III and Ibleam IV, which long remained a classic example of the hit-and-run tactic. This raid was the beginning of the end of the Feyd regime, as their forces began to swiftly lose ground to rebel attacks.

Estil died of natural causes in 1099. At the time of his death, only a few worlds remained under the control of his regime. He was succeeded as emperor by his son, Feyd II.

Ezhar's reign ended in 561, when Kalus became the ruler of the Imperium as Protector, beginning the First Protectorate. The Corrino line was eventually restored to the throne with Ezhar's brother Audrii I in 603.

entities.description:
Farok's son was a young Fremen who had been a Jihadi Soldier during the Naraj campaign where he was blinded during the Battle of Naraj by a Stone burner attack.

Unable to find a suitable wife, as his father had neglected the Fremen tradition to expel his disabled son into the deep Desert, his son befriended Lichna, daughter of Otheym and made her a Semuta addict to attach her to himself.

Farok's son was murdered along with Lichna and his father by Scytale when the Face Dancer adapted Lichna's identity.

entities.description:
Emperor Feyd II (d. 1099) was briefly Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1099 AG), succeeding his father Estil II as ruler of the Imperium.

Feyd II became emperor in 1099, after the death of his father Estil II. By this time, only a few worlds remained under the control of the Feyd regime, most having been lost to the rebels supporting a restoration of House Corrino. Feyd was murdered by his own officers after ruling for only two weeks. In his place, the Corrino heir Josif I was named emperor, ending the rule of the House of Feyd.

entities.name: Fredhrick II
entities.description:
Fredhrick II was the second Emperor of the House of Hajus Corrino. He and his sister Alia VII were the children of Fredhrick I al-Hajus and the Imperial Consort, Duchess Hippolute Atreides.

Fredhrick II and Alia VII ascended the throne as joint rulers after the death of Fredherick I in 7456 AG.

He and Alia VII were succeeded after her death in 7519 AG by her son (Fredherick II's nephew) Sidir XVIII.

entities.name: Glax Othn
entities.description:
Glax Othn was a Docent of House Taligari. A wise politician and scholar, he often acted as spokesman in the Senate at Artisia, since there were few surviving members of the Taligari family. A tall and silver haired man, with a dignified bearing.

Emperor Elrood Corrino IX chose Othn as guardian to his bastard son by Shando Balut, Tyros Reffa, warning him that the child should never aspire the heritage of House Corrino. Othn raised Tyros to become a man of honor, values, and above all, politically correct and with a deep sense of the responsibility a ruler should have while ruling his subjects. Reffa lived in Zanovar as rich man, and owned vast estates. In his youth, he had also joined the Jongleurs to become an actor.

After realizing the existence of this Corrino bastard, Shaddam IV ordered the attack on Zanovar, using as a pretext the first strike of his Great Spice War on Zanovar's amusement park, where a giant replica of a Sandworm filled with spice was located. Prior to the attack, several imperial agents had tried to know more about Reffa while pretending to buy their mansion at Zanovar. Othn revealed to Tyros the true identities of the "buyers" and gave Reffa as a gift a ticket to the Ingravid Opera at Artisia, the Taligari capital, while Reffa gave him a ticket to Zanovar's amusement park, telling him to entertain himself and leave for a while his scholar interests and responsibilities.

Tragically, while Othn was at the amusement park, playing with children and seeing them play, the Sardaukar fleet arrived and the massacre started. To Othn's horror, he saw how the Imperial troops executed men, women, and children in a blink. Wounded by a shot, he was discovered by Supreme Bashar Zum Garon, the commander of the Sardaukar, and horrified by the slaughter, he yelled:

entities.description:
Emperor Halleck I was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 2413–2458 AG). Halleck became emperor through his marriage to Empress Alia II (r. 2411–2441), whom he co-ruled the Corrino Imperium with until 2441 AG. He then served as sole ruler until 2458 (Alia presumably having died).

Halleck established a new branch of House Corrino as the Imperial House, the House of Halleck Corrino. He was succeeded in 2458 by his son Halleck II.

entities.name: Planet
entities.description:
A planet is a celestial body in orbit around a star, but neither a star nor a moon, and had cleared out the area around its orbit as it formed by causing all other smaller bodies in its orbit to accrete with it. As a consequence, it will not share its orbital region with any other bodies of significant size, except for moons or those collected later under its gravitational influence.

Depending on the tilt of the planet's axis, planets also have varied seasons with ranging temperatures and weather. Planets are extremely varied in terms of environmental conditions and landscape.

All habitable planets contain at least 19% oxygen in their atmosphere.

The chemical composition of a planet depends upon its distance from the main star. Some planets consist primarily of: silicates, hydrogen (quasi-stars), or sulfides, while some are mostly metallic.

It was a place worse even than Arrakis in some respects. According to Mother Superior Darwi Odrade, who had once been sent there, it had "high cliffs and dry gorges, hot winds and frigid winds, too little moisture and too much." Category:Planets

entities.description:
Aramanli was a location, possibly a planet.

It was given to Count Iason Atreides by Emperor Audrii I in 635 AG, and House Atreides/DE had been Counts of Aramanli.

It remained the main Atreides fief, until usurper Feyd I branded the House members as traitors and Baron Andreas von Wikkheizer received the fief.

entities.name: Arbelough
entities.description:
Arbelough was the site of a battle at which Bashar Miles Teg was present. Arbelough had been perverted by Face Dancers and Teg's aides urged their commander to sterilize the planet but Teg refused to and spared the enemy, apart from the Face Dancers.

Following two days of heavy losses at Arbelough, Teg admitting that he had underestimated the fervour of the opposing force, the Bashar led his troops from the front into battle to show that he shared the same risks they did. Later Teg also walked unarmed through enemy ranks before they laid down their weapons to assure them that they would not be mistreated.

entities.description:
Artisia was the capital planet of House Taligari, where both the Senate and the Ingravid Opera were located.

A general meeting in the Senate took place in Artisia after the attack of the Sardaukar against Zanovar, where Glax Othn, who acted as spokesman of House Taligari, was murdered along with 14 million people.

entities.name: Balut
entities.description:
Balut was a colony League World planet. It seems it was ruled by a Patriarch.

In 164 BG, the colony was devastated by Jipol and Tlulaxa slavers led by Iblis Ginjo, to use for the organ farms. The ships came at night and bombarded the central village, sprayed paralytic gas.

They took several captives alive for slaves and killed a handful of citizens for good measure, just so they could strew the slaughtered bodies around, leaving destroyed combat robots so that the League of Nobles believe it was a result of Thinking Machine attack.

It was decimated by the Omnius Scourge, and by 88 BG it had not recovered fully.

entities.description:
was a jungle world during the time of the Great Spice War and the site of a war memorial on the Senasar plateau

Around 10175 AG, the troops of House Atreides and House Vernius made a desperate last stand against the Sardaukar armies, the protectors of the Imperial House Corrino.

The Swordmaster Duncan Idaho led the Atreides soldiers alongside their allies strike to destroy the archeological digs, thwarting the Tleilaxu yet again.

entities.name: Bela Tegeuse
entities.description:
Bela Tegeuse was the fifth planet in the Kuentsing star system.

It was reputed to be the third stopping place of the Zensunni forced migration.

While "Kuentsing" is often identified with Alpha or Beta Leporis, it in fact refers to the star Iota Leporis. The Chinese asterism of Kuentsing (army well) specifically refers to Iota, Kappa, Lambda, and Nu Leporis. Of these, Iota is the first in the sequence (1st army well) and is the most reasonable distance from Old Earth at 231.81 light years away.

It was later conquered by the Honored Matres.
