entities.name: Borhees
entities.description:
was a small planet of reasonable wealth and size, ruled by the House Kolona and the Count and Countess Kolona. It had a 'tolerable' climate and was a member of the Imperium for over a millennium. The planet had rivers and river villages which were occasionally wiped out by floods and Ice storms were not an uncommon occurrence.

House Kolona was attacked by the Sardaukar almost two decades before 10191 AG. The Sardaukar were disguised as Atreides soldiers, shifting the blame onto House Atreides as the Padishah Emperor Elrood IX desired the planet's wealth. The planet became a secondary holding of House Atreides and Paulus Atreides became the Duke of Borhees but hardly visited the planet. Much of the Borhees wealth was absorbed into the Imperial Treasury. Years later the son of Paulus, Leto Atreides discovered that the occupation of Borhees was illegitimate and attempted to return it to the extended Kolona family heirs but the current Emperor Shaddam IV dismissed the notion in fury.

entities.name: Buzzell
entities.description:
Buzzell was a planet most famous for the lustrous Soostones that were found in its seas. Around the time of the Butlerian Jihad, Buzzell was an Unallied World.

During Elrood Corrino IX's rule, a soostone skimming operation took place, and a CHOAM scandal: a family of royal impersonators who disappeared to a rogue planet somewhere beyond Imperial control caused lost profits for Buzzell and the adjoining systems.

It housed a Bene Gesserit Keep. As Buzzell was not a very hospitable world the Bene Gesserit punished those who refused to conform to their ideals by sending them there, including those who had committed the crime of love.

Buzzell was the first planet retaken from the Honored Matres by the New Sisterhood and their armada of no-ships. On the planet the disgraced Reverend Mothers were rescued by the Mother Commander of the New Sisterhood and one was made overseer of the soostone harvesting, after argumentative Honored Matres were dealt with.
entities.short_description: Buzzell was a planet most famous for the lustrous Soostones that were found in its seas. Around the time of the Butlerian Jihad, Buzzell was an Unallied World.

entities.name: Cerbol
entities.description:
Cerbol was the site of an uprising that was stopped by Bashar Miles Teg through a non-violent confrontation following a series of battles.

A significant portion of Cerbol's workforce (and later of the rebel force) consisted of retired veterans, many of whom had served alongside Miles Teg. Cerbol possessed a number of fields, which were ravaged by the conflict, and a warm climate with a scorching noon heat, suggesting suitability for arable farming.

entities.name: Ceres
entities.description:
Ceres was one of the first planet colonies of humanity, perhaps during the Little Diaspora.

When a planetoid struck Terra in 13402 BG, Ceres became the new capital of the Imperial Seat.

From Ceres the Empire expanded and became the Empire of Ten Worlds and then the Empire of a Thousand Worlds

However a rebellion erupted and Ceres was destroyed in 11105 BG. Thus begun the Age of Pretenders

Chalcedony was a location, probably a planet, given to Count Odusseus Atreides in 1099 AG after House Corrino was restored to the Imperial throne, soon after the coronation of Josif I. Achilleus Atreides used the money from Chalcedony family estates in order to invest in CHOAM shares of undeveloped worlds.

entities.name: Chapterhouse
entities.description:
Chapterhouse was the term used by the Bene Gesserit for the planet considered to be their home base. The planet that 'Chapterhouse' referred to changed over the centuries of the existence of the Bene Gesserit. Speculation would put the original Bene Gesserit home base on the planet Rossak.

The planet was used as the secret headquarters of the Bene Gesserit is seen as a temporary base, and because of this the planet was never quite 100% settled and if needed, the Bene Gesserit could completely abandon the planet on very short notice leaving very little trace of their time spent.

Chapterhouse was on the same planet for more than 1,500 years, which means "temporary" headquarters was somewhat of a loose term.

The final planet was used as the Bene Gesserit headquarters from approximately the time of Leto II's death onward. They utilized No-ships in a defensive, encapsulating perimeter around the planet to mask its existence from prescient individuals who may be searching for the location of their headquarters, such as the Honored Matres.

Corrin was a location near the star Sigma Draconis, from which the Battle of Corrin (88 BG) and the House Corrino derived their names.

The victor took the regnal name of Corrino in remembrance of the battle.

entities.name: Corrin quasi-nebula
entities.description:
Corrin quasi-nebula is a formation near the planet Corrin in the Sigma Draconis system, to which owes its name.

It is the result of the collision (c. 250 BG) of a huge planetoid with the substellar companion of Sigma Draconis, perhaps caused by an illicit mining and smelting operation.

It comprises dust, solid bodies, and hot gases that form debris that fills the system.

It was the place of the Battle of Corrin and was still highly agitated at that time, which caused the battle to be so long-lasting (two hours).

entities.description:
Crompton was the fourth planet circling the distant star Sutterer 4041. It was named after Levas Crompton, the captain of the Guild ship Tharondelai, who first officially discovered it in 14701 AG; it was home to the enigmatic Crompton Ruins.

Crompton's ecosystem was nearly ideal for human habitation, with only the relatively high water vapour content in the atmosphere a minor inconvenience.

The discovery of the Ruins confirmed that other lifeforms, almost certainly human, had visited the planet before the arrival of the first Crompton expedition.

entities.description: Culat was a planet in the Known Universe. It was the homeworld of Lars Siewesca, the Planetologist appointed by Padishah Emperor Paul Atreides to terra-form the devastated world of Salusa Secundus. Category:Planets

entities.name: Draconis IV
entities.description:
Located in the Sigma Draconis star system, Draconis IV was an ice world and the home planet of the House Ordos.

Draconis 4 is believed to have been settled by Humans originating in Earth's China, other theories however have supposed settlers with Roman or Egyptian roots. Before the Butlerian Jihad Draconis IV was known to be home to Mercenaries allied with the Jihadists.

In the Old Empire Draconis 4 was also known as Ishkal and was one of several waystations of the Wandering Zensunni.

Eventually a couple of several wealthy indigenious families evolved into one large cartel which could claim the status of a Great House, thanks to their economic success as merchants and financiers.

entities.name: Dur
entities.description:
, or The Dur was a bushy, canyon filled, jungle planet outside the Known Universe, which was inhabited during Scattering. The planet was home to the Frame bush, a semi-sentient plant that could morph into biological architecture. The phrase 'Holy rock of Dur', and variations thereof, was commonly used. The Honored Matres often used the phrase. They also used the phrase 'Dear Gods of Dur', indicating that there was some form of religion on the planet. At some point, Great Honored Matre Dama lived on the planet. She reminisced of a simpler time on Dur, without Futars. She compared the interior of the control center on Junction to that of Dur.

The planet had a military force. Jafa Muzzafar was the leader of the Forces of Dur. The title Field Marshal was a title used during the ancient times of Dur.

entities.name: Duvalle
entities.description:
Duvalle was a human-occupied world colonized during The Scattering, and one of the first attacked during the final plan to exterminate human-kind by Omnius and the reborn Thinking Machine Empire, during the advent of Kralizec.

With the planets Ronto and Pital; Duvalle first experienced what would be Omnius's plan to wipe out humanity. Send probes seeded with the dreaded Omnius Scourge to planet first, almost wiping out the population of the world. Then the survivors would be barely able to defend the world against the Thinking Machine's million-starship space Armada.

entities.description:
mother religions. They met "in the common belief that there exists a Divine Essence in the universe." Every faith with more than a million followers was represented, and they reached a surprisingly immediate agreement on the statement of their common goal

Earth, also called Old Earth, Terra, or Old Terra, was a planet located in the al-Lat star system. The human species originated there.

It was on a neutral island of Old Earth where the Commission of Ecumenical Translators converged to assemble the Orange Catholic Bible after the Butlerian Jihad.

During the reign of Emperor Paul Atreides the "Golden Age of Earth" was considered nothing more than myths from the dawn of time. Little information was known about the old times, owing to the pittance of data which the Butlerians left behind. Paul asked that Stilgar look into historical Terran references found in the Golden Age including Genghis Khan and Adolf Hitler for a comparison to him. Scytale also knew of Earth and remembered the Golden Age and the camels of the planet. Laza tigers were genetically manipulated Terran tigers. Kulons were adapted Terran Ass. Conch Shells were found in Seas on Earth. Sage was a common plant with an aroma. When used in food, it added flavor. Heisenberg was an individual who 'showed humans the walls enclosing our predestined arguments.'

entities.name: Ecaz
entities.description:
Ecaz was the fourth Planet orbiting Alpha Centauri B.

The planet was the source of Fogwood, apparently favoured by artists because it could be shaped solely by human thought. For this the planet was nicknamed "The sculptor's paradise."

Other famous plants of Ecaz was elacca wood which gave the elacca drug and Semuta, a highly addictive narcotic favoured by many in the Old Imperium, the truth serum verite, sapho, pleniscenta and the hufuf vine which gave the Krimskel Fiber.

Ecaz was captured by the Honored Matres in 15230 AG, some time before the death of Great Honored Matre Dama.
entities.short_description: Ecaz was the fourth Planet orbiting Alpha Centauri B.

entities.name: Eluzai
entities.description:
Due to Ivan Harkonnen's heroic stand in the Battle of Corrin, his son, Nikolai, was made Duke of Eluzai by Sheuset I.

Saudir IV was the last Duke of Eluzai He never married, and the Duchy of Eluzai became extinct at his death. category:House Harkonnen category:planets

entities.name: Enfeil
entities.description:
Enfeil was a planet in the Known Universe. It was conquered by the Ninth Legion of Muad'dib's Jihad, led by the Bashar Farok, in the Battle of Enfeil.

The planet had mountains, seas and trees. Farok immersed himself in one of its seas, the water of which was bitter and made him ill. The planet had a sun.
entities.short_description: Enfeil was a planet in the Known Universe. It was conquered by the Ninth Legion of Muad'dib's Jihad, led by the Bashar Farok, in the Battle of Enfeil.

entities.name: Extaris
entities.description:
Extaris is the fourth planet of the Canopus system/DE.

Extaris, is the smallest of the outer planetary bodies. Because of similarities of size and orbit, Menaris and Extaris are informally referred to as "the Twins." Their combination is responsible for the highly eccentric orbit of the third planet, Arrakis.

The primary constituents of Extaris's atmosphere are:

Weather is essentially benign due to three factors
entities.short_description: Extaris is the fourth planet of the Canopus system/DE.

entities.name: Gallatin
entities.description:
was a planet ruled by House Atreides as Siridar Dukes.

It was a colony where they moved from Hestia to escape the massacre of the First Republic.

In 4552 AG, Emperor Atreus Atreides Atreides restored the Imperium and appointed his Cousin Duke Pausanias VIII Atreides as Siridar Duke of Gallatin.

During 8711 AG it was ruled by Duke Philippos Atreides. His brother built Castle Caladan. Eventually Elrood VIII granted Caladan to Paulos XVI Atreides who moved his family there in 8722 AG.
entities.short_description: was a planet ruled by House Atreides as Siridar Dukes.

entities.name: Gamma Vertis VII
entities.description:
Gamma Vertis VII was an inhabited planet. The Tailara language was spoken.

There was a legend concerning the hetman Sharkala who became a constellation.

People were taken to Bela Tegeuse as slaves.
entities.short_description: Gamma Vertis VII was an inhabited planet. The Tailara language was spoken.

entities.name: Gamont
entities.description:
Gamont was the third planet of the Niushe system, as Grumman was the second. During the time of the Faufreluches, it was a planet noted for its hedonistic culture and exotic sexual practices. A male sex slave with attractive eyes was purchased by Vladimir Harkonnen, the head of the infamous House Harkonnen, during a visit there.

Thousands of years later, the world was conquered by the Honored Matres, prior to their merging with the Bene Gesserit.

entities.name: Ginaz
entities.description:
was a planet made famous for its Swordmasters. It was also the ancestral home of House Ginaz, who were ultimately defeated by House Moritani in a War of Assassins.

Its size and atmosphere was very similar to Old Earth, although its surface was covered in more water (over 90%). The land area consisted of scattered sandy archipelagos with minimal vegetation.

The world had long been inhabited by a small but ferocious culture of warrior humans. These people played an important role during the Butlerian Jihad, where they fought as mercenaries in close combat against the thinking machines.

In 164 BG Hecate's asteroid fell on the planet, caused a massive tsunami that engulfed most of the colonized islands but after seven decades, the civilization was rebuilt.

entities.description: was a planet in the Known Universe. It was ruled by the House Lucifera, a House notable for its production of Glowglobes. Category:Planets

entities.name: Grand Hain
entities.description:
Grand Hain was an inhospitable world in which the gravity of the planet was several times greater what was considered "normal" for humans.

One known human male from Grand Hain was the planetologist Qhomba. Category:Planets
entities.short_description: Grand Hain was an inhospitable world in which the gravity of the planet was several times greater what was considered "normal" for humans.

entities.name: Grumman
entities.description:
Grumman was the second planet of the Niushe star system (the third planet being the pleasure world Gamont). During the days of the Old Imperium it was the ancestral home of House Moritani.

House Moritani is principally known for its defeat of House Ginaz in a War of Assassins. House Atreides involvement in this war possibly was Duncan Idaho's first real experience in mortal combat as he stated that his "sword was first blooded on Grumman".

The planetary name may have been suggested by the name for Xi Draconis: Grumium, meaning "jaw (of the dragon)".
entities.short_description: Grumman was the second planet of the Niushe star system (the third planet being the pleasure world Gamont). During the days of the Old Imperium it was the ancestral home of House Moritani.

entities.name: Hagal
entities.description:
Hagal, also known as the "Jewel Planet", was the second planet of the Theta Shaowei star system. It was ruled by a County General.

It was the planet where many of the precious crown jewels of the Known Universe originated from. Hagal was particularly famous for its soostones and fire opals.

Hagal was mined out completely in the time of Padishah Emperor Shaddam I. Subsequent emperors sat upon a throne made from a single piece of translucent blue-green Hagal quartz.

The planet Hagal was home of House Hagal.
entities.short_description: Hagal, also known as the "Jewel Planet", was the second planet of the Theta Shaowei star system. It was ruled by a County General.

entities.name: Harmonthep
entities.description: Harmonthep was a planet orbiting the star Delta Pavonis. Inglsey noted Harmonthep as the sixth stop in the Zensunni Wanderers' migration. At some point in time, there was a slave rebellion on Harmonthep and the Fremen held a ceremony that mourned it, as well as the similar events on Poritrin, Bela Tegeuse and Rossak. The planet was eventually totally destroyed.

entities.name: Hassika V
entities.description:
Hassika V was the planet where Empress Habla Corrino was born.

It was mentioned as the home planet of origin of Habla during the negotiations between her son, Crown Prince Shaddam, and the Bene Gesserit representative, Margot Rashino-Zea.

Because of the ascension of Habla as Empress and wife of Emperor Elrood IX, the Ecazi Revolt took place.

Category:Expanded Dune Category:Planets Category:Prelude to Dune
entities.short_description: Hassika V was the planet where Empress Habla Corrino was born.

entities.name: Hessra
entities.description:
Hessra was an ice-covered planet. Curiously, its thick ice was greenish-blue from chemical contaminants that had settled out of the planet's sour atmosphere.

It became historically important by the Cogitors prior to and around the time of the Butlerian Jihad. Because of its inhospitality, the Ivory Tower Cogitors chose that location to be perpetually secluded from all external events and interference.

The Cogitors remained on a stronghold on an exposed tongue of mountain high above a canyon. It was apartized of black metal towers and cylindrical protrusions with pointed domes. When Serena Butler visited the planet, a glacier had slanted and was beginning to enfold the towers.

After the initial Jihad conflict the unguarded and secluded world was conquered by the Titans, who prized the Cogitor's electrafluid manufacturing facilities.
entities.short_description: Hessra was an ice-covered planet. Curiously, its thick ice was greenish-blue from chemical contaminants that had settled out of the planet's sour atmosphere.

entities.name: Hestia
entities.description:
Hestia was a planet given to Siridar Count Peleus Atreides in 2201 AG by Emperor Shahrukh Kenric I.

During the First Republic it was the House Atreides home, from which they were withdrawn to Gallatin.

In 9355 AG, with the assumption of tPhilippos XIV Atreides to Dukedom, the Siridar-Duke's brother, Count Garrick Atreides and all his family were taken hostage when a rebel force attacked the planet.

The invaders wished to bargain with the lives of the Atreides — known loyalists to the Crown — in order to obtain passage to Tupile from emperor Ezhar XI. The emperor replied with his usual firmness; After sending a rather cryptic message of apology to the captives, he ordered his troops to raze Hestia completely.
entities.short_description: Hestia was a planet given to Siridar Count Peleus Atreides in 2201 AG by Emperor Shahrukh Kenric I.

entities.name: III Delta Kaising
entities.description: III Delta Kaising was one of only two planets in the entire Known Universe where shigawire was grown. The other planet was Salusa Secundus.
entities.short_description: III Delta Kaising was one of only two planets in the entire Known Universe where shigawire was grown. The other planet was Salusa Secundus.

entities.description: III Delta Pavonis was the third planet in the Delta Pavonis star system. It was, at one point, the home to the Zen Hekiganshu religion. It was better known as Caladan or Dan. Category:Planets

entities.name: Ipyr
entities.description:
Ipyr was a lush, green world and the primary home-world of House Thorvald, which governed the planet as an Earldom in the Landsraad. Ipyr was Planetary Ruler Memnon Thorvald's base of operations during the first rebellion against Emperor Paul-Muad'Dib, from 10194 to 10,198 AG.

When the Emperor found out about the Earl's upcoming strike against his former home planet of Caladan, Paul ordered Stilgar and his Jihadi Fremen to completely sterilize the planet and render it lifeless. Stilgar executed this task in 10198 AG and Ipyr was inable to grow or contain life afterward.

Category:Planets Category:Heroes of Dune

entities.name: Ishia
entities.description:
Ishia was the second planet of Beta Tygri, a Corrino holding which had been allowed to lie fallow since its discovery.

Ishia was the opposite of Rossak: hot, arid, oppressing to its life forms with heat as Rossak did with cold. Crops which survived did so only because of tremendous amounts of time and energy spent in careful irrigation. The system had to be constantly watched, as a single day's deprivation could kill a field. It was called Albudeite (scarce water) by the Wandering Zensunni
entities.short_description: Ishia was the second planet of Beta Tygri, a Corrino holding which had been allowed to lie fallow since its discovery.

entities.name: Ishkal
entities.description:
Ishkal is the fourth planet orbiting Sigma Draconis. It is believed that the word Shai-Hulud was first taken by the Zensunni Wanderers off this planet .

In Dune 2000 Draconis IV is home to house Ordos.

entities.name: Ix
entities.description:
Ix was a planet which derived its name from its status as the ninth planet in its star system. The Ixian economy depended on manufacturing complex machinery, which sometimes flouts the moral-juridical proscriptions of the Butlerian Jihad. The inhabitants of Ix were known collectively as the Ixians.

The planet Ix's name originated with a misinterpretation of the Roman numeral IX (9).

Ix, along with Richese, escaped the more severe effects of the Butlerian Jihad, leading to it being classed as supreme in machine culture.

The planet formed an Ixian Confederacy when Paul Atreides took the Golden Lion Throne and became Emperor of the Known Universe in 10196 AG. Ix offered submission to House Atreides in 10208 AG in exchange for a legal limit to Paul's Imperial tax, claiming that they wanted a constitution, with the Landsraad or CHOAM governing Paul. Paul forbade a constitution, claiming it would be detrimental to his people. This became an Order in Council and Paul decreed that the if the Guild wanted his signature for the Tupile Treaty, they were to stop all trade from Ix until the Confederacy agreed to the tax. Without the Guild's transport, the Ixians eventually submitted.

Thomas Atreides was made Duke of Jaddua in 207 AG and received the planet as a planetary fiefdom after he helped restored Elrood II to the Golden Lion Throne. In 346 AG, Thomas II Atreides was executed and the planets rulership was transferred to Alman IV, who became the Duke.

entities.name: Jericha
entities.description:
Jericha was a temperate planet that was used as a base of guerilla warfare during the uprising of Earl Memnon Thorvald in the first few years of the reign of Emperor Paul Muad'Dib. It's climate was mainly tundra.

In 10,196 AG, the Emperor sent Jihadi troops under the command of the Atreides general Burbage, and the Fremen leader Stilgar. After the forces of House Thorvald caused most of the aircraft to crash due to their use suspensor nullification equipment; Burbage and Stilgar had to attack them using ruh-yaks to carry their armnaments.

While crossing a river stream on the side of a Jericha mountain, Stilgar fell into the water, and had a near-death experience. Though he came close to death, he was rescued by Burbage, who personally pulled him from the water. After this experience, Stilgar decided to return to Arrakis, to become Paul's closest advisor. Eventually, the forces of Thorvald, and his allies, were routed from Jericha.

entities.name: Junction
entities.description:
The name Junction was used to refer to both multiple planets or planetary objects used for Spacing Guild operations, and to a primary center for Guild activity.

In the latter case, this main planet served as the headquarters for the Spacing Guild and its bank. It was also the location of the only Navigator school. The surface of the planet was almost completely covered with landing fields and repair bays for Heighliners.

Junction was also the location of the Navigator's Field, where Guild Navigators who had died were memorialized.

It was conquered by the Honored Matres during the return from the Scattering, and was the home of the Great Honored Matre and the location of the eventual Battle of Junction.

entities.name: Jupiter
entities.description:
Jupiter was the gas giant, fifth planet of the star Sol, located past the orbital area of the Asteroid Belt and the gas giant Saturn. Jupiter, a ringed sphere, is the largest planet of the Sol solar system, and has a large constellation of orbiting satellites.

Vorian Atreides used the gravitational pull of Jupiter as a slingshot effect to enable his starship, the Dream Voyager carrying Iblis Ginjo and Serena Butler, to escape from his Titan pursuing father, Agamemnon. As Vorian's vessel was large enough to escape from the planet's gravitational well, the Cymeks star voyaging craft was unable to do so, and Agamemnon had to break off the pursuit.

entities.name: Kadesh
entities.description: Kadesh was a planet in the Known Universe. It was a style among the population to wear one's hair down to their shoulders in a particular way. Tagir Mohandis was a troubadour that hailed from Kadesh.

entities.name: Kaitain
entities.description:
The planet was the second capital of the Corrino Empire. The seat of the empire was moved from the original House Corrino seat, Salusa Secundus, which became the prison and training ground for the imperial Sardaukar.

Above Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV's door on Kaitain were the words 'Law is the ultimate science'. The Hall of Portraits was a location, presumably on Kaitain, containing the Ego-likeness of prominent figures. Shaddam brought his eldest daughter Irulan into the hall in 10190 AG and showed her the portrait of Leto Atreides I, lamenting that Irulan had not been of age when Leto was looking for a partner.

After the fall of Corrino Empire in the Desert War, House Corrino left Kaitain and moved back to Salusa Secundus.

entities.name: Kolhar
entities.description:
Kolhar was a cold and largely barren planet located near the Rossak system, and on the nearby trade routes from Ginaz. Despite being uninhabited, it's environment was viable by humans.

Norma Cenva, after her torment and transformation, used Xerxes's ship to transport herself there. She then left a telepathic signal and summoned her mother Zufa Cenva there.

Having a minimal human population prior to the Butlerian Jihad, the planet was quickly transformed by Norma Cenva into the manufacturing center for Spacefolder space vessels.

Near the end of Josef Venport's conflict with Manford Torondo's Butlerians, eight decades after the end of the Jihad, Torondo manages to obtain a cache of forbidden atomics and uses them to turn Kolhar into a radioactive wasteland. Venport himself survives along with all the Navigators on the planet, but most of his employees and much of his industrial infrastructure are lost.

entities.description: Kronin was a planet on which the legend of Ampoliros appeared. It was later captured by the Honored Matres at some time before the death of Great Honored Matre Dama.
entities.short_description: Kronin was a planet on which the legend of Ampoliros appeared. It was later captured by the Honored Matres at some time before the death of Great Honored Matre Dama.

entities.name: Lampadas
entities.description:
Shortly after the conclusion of the Butlerian Jihad, a remote marshland area of Lampadas was selected by Gilbertus Albans as the original location of the Mentat School.

15 millennia later, Lampadas was the site of a Bene Gesserit Keep and was the site of their main educational and library facilities. Lampadas was one of the many planets the Honored Matres attacked on their return from the Scattering to the Old Empire. 7,622,014 Reverend Mothers were posted at Lampadas at the time of the Honored Matre attack and despite the efforts of the Bashar Burzmali only one Reverend Mother - Lucilla - managed to escape the planet alive, though she did carry the Shared memories of all her deceased Sisterhood on Lampadas.

entities.name: Lankiveil
entities.description:
Lankiveil was a cold maritime planet in the Corrino Empire. Its chief export was whale fur, desired by many of the very wealthy throughout the Imperium. It was one of the many planets controlled by House Harkonnen due to its place in the whale fur trade. A sect of the Buddislam religion was dominant in the planet culture.

Prior to 10132 AG, Abulurd Harkonnen was given the subdistrict governorship of Rabban-Lankiveil. Afterwards, he renounced the Harkonnen name and adopted the surname of his wife's family, Rabban. Rabban and his wife had two sons, Glossu Rabban and Feyd-Rautha Rabban.

Glossu succeeded his father as Count of Lankiveil until 10193 AG, when House Harkonnen was defeated and dissolved by the actions of Paul Atreides.

entities.name: Lernaeus
entities.description:
Lernaeus was a quiet agrarian world which revolved around a standard sequence yellow sun.

It was the homeworld of the famous Bene Gesserit mentat Bashar Miles Teg, whose mother, Janet Roxbrough, belonged to one of the planet's dominant families. Teg was brought out of retirement on Lernaeus to combat the Honored Matres.

The planet was capable of sustaining human life, as well as maintain a photosynthesis range that allowed for the growing of crops. This was apparent due to the large crop farm the Teg family owned and managed there.

entities.name: Liesco II
entities.description:
Liesco II was the second planet of the Liesco system.

During the Great Dark Ages the planet was governed by House Holtzman which brought up the famed scientist Ibrahim Vaughn Holtzman. The planet had advanced medical sciences and after an accident, Holtzman became one of the first individuals whose brain was transplanted in a prototype axolotl tank wired to a computer.

Subsequently, he fled to space, and used the planetary mass of Liesco II itself to emit his next messages, explaining his discoveries to the excitement of the academic community of the planet.

Liesco II participated in the Wars of Reunification caused by Holtzman himself. Bye 5694 BG the wars were very ferocious.
entities.short_description: Liesco II was the second planet of the Liesco system.

entities.name: Lishash
entities.description:
Lishash is a planet that formed the Lishash Confederation and was devastated.

Several centuries after the foundation of CHOAM, certain houses defied the Padishah supremacy. There was also a proposed division of shares increasing the emperor's votes on the CHOAM board from 20-21%. In this, the Lishasha saw creeping monopoly.

Other houses which shared their views allied themselves with Lishash and formed the Lishash Confederation.

The Confederation organized a rebellion which lasted from 385 AG until 388 AG. Regend Henli I ordered a retribution who invaded the LC planets adopting a policy of ruthless assaults followed by the razing of the captured territory leaving no prisoners.
entities.short_description: Lishash is a planet that formed the Lishash Confederation and was devastated.

entities.name: Menaris
entities.description:
Menaris was the second planet inward of the Canopus system. Because of similarities of size and orbit, Menaris and Extaris were informally referred to as "the Twins." Their combination was responsible for the highly eccentric orbit of the third planet, Arrakis. It iswasmuch larger in radius than Seban.

Because of the above, the planet nearly rolled in its orbit with contrasting seasonal effects, one hemisphere eternally hot and the other eternally cold although the atmosphere mitigates the temperature effects to some extent.

Menaris possessed a dense atmosphere of carbon dioxide with traces of nitrogen dioxide (which was responsible for the yellow brown tint). Largely because of its oxidizing atmosphere, there was no known life on Menaris.

entities.description: Molitor was a Planet in the Known Universe. It was the location of Battle of Molitor. Following the battle, the Fremen Fedaykin held a feast in celebration. The nights of the planet were cold.

entities.name: Naraj
entities.description:
Naraj was a group of planets in the Known Universe. It was forcibly absorbed into the Atreides Empire during the Conquest of Naraj, a battle of Muad'dib's Jihad in which the Naraj defenders activated a Stone burner Scytale recognised a song popular on the Naraj worlds.

The Tleilaxu Face Dancer Scytale, while undercover as Zaal, told Farok that, in his youth, he and a group of Face Dancers had toured the Naraj worlds.

During Muad'dib's Jihad, Jihadi crusaders took control of the Naraj worlds in the Conquest of Naraj. During the battle, the Naraj defenders used a Stone burner, an outlawed atomic device which had the side effect of decimating the eye tissue of those in a certain range. Farok's son was too close to the device and was blinded during the battle. He was nursed to health on the planet and fathered children, but returned to Arrakis in hopes of winning a Fremen wife.

entities.name: Neta-class
entities.description:
The Neta class was a planetary class. The planetary classification system has its origins in Marta Ptahtercicah's work.

Specifically the planets comprising this definition are composed of: 60 ± 10% silicates (by mass), 30 ± 10% metals, 10 ± 5% sulfides and less than 5% hydrogen. During their formation, their surfaces and interiors became molten.

Only some Neta planets exhibit plate tectonics behavior. Arrakis/DE is more tectonically active than any other Neta planet. In the Terran system there were 4 Neta-class planets.

Deserts on Neta planets commonly have whirls.
entities.short_description: The Neta class was a planetary class. The planetary classification system has its origins in Marta Ptahtercicah's work.

entities.name: Niushe
entities.description: Niushe was a colonized planet located in, and named after, the star Niushe. Niushe, along with its neighboring planets, was captured by the Honored Matres during their invasion of the known universe.
entities.short_description: Niushe was a colonized planet located in, and named after, the star Niushe. Niushe, along with its neighboring planets, was captured by the Honored Matres during their invasion of the known universe.

entities.name: Norstrilia
entities.description:
Norstrilia was planet famous for their Merino Sheep.

The Merino Sheep wool was exported to other planets like to the Fremen of Arrakis.
entities.short_description: Norstrilia was planet famous for their Merino Sheep.

entities.name: Nossus
entities.description: Nossus was a tempered and isolated planet inhabited by a low population used by Jaxson Aru as a hideout during is rebellion against the Imperium.
entities.short_description: Nossus was a tempered and isolated planet inhabited by a low population used by Jaxson Aru as a hideout during is rebellion against the Imperium.

entities.name: Novebruns
entities.description:
Novebruns was a planet that originally belonged to House Metulli.

During the time of Alia's Regency, half of planet Novebruns was sold by the Metulli Family for three hundred and twenty one litres of the spice melange.
entities.short_description: Novebruns was a planet that originally belonged to House Metulli.

entities.name: Otorio
entities.description:
Otorio is a remote planet chosen by the Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV for the location of is new Imperial museum. It was a huge complex, shaped like an inverted pyramid where monuments and fountains filled the large surrounding streets.

It was the site of an assassination attempt on the Emperor by Jaxson Aru. Three heavy containers, filled with explosives dived from the orbit aiming at the city-museum. With the help of Leto Atreides, the Emperor and a few nobles escaped before the container ships hit the planet. A huge crater was left on the surface after the impact.

entities.name: Palma
entities.description: Palma was a planet that housed a Bene Gesserit Keep. This Keep - along with the eleven hundred Reverend Mothers stationed there - had to be written off by Mother Superior Darwi Odrade because of the threat of imminent attack on Palma by the Honored Matres and the fact that the Keep could not be defended or evacuated in time.

entities.description: Parlon was a planet that was attacked by the Butlerian Jihad in 191 BG. Casualties were notably low, as was the goal of the Jihad.
entities.short_description: Parlon was a planet that was attacked by the Butlerian Jihad in 191 BG. Casualties were notably low, as was the goal of the Jihad.

entities.name: Pedmiot
entities.description: Pedmiot was a planet in the Known Universe. Ernso was captured on Pedmiot and sold to the House Harkonnen as a slave.
entities.short_description: Pedmiot was a planet in the Known Universe. Ernso was captured on Pedmiot and sold to the House Harkonnen as a slave.

entities.name: Peridot Colony
entities.description:
Peridot Colony was a human colony. The Army of the Jihad had no presence in the area.

It became a battlefield early in the Butlerian Jihad. The Colony was attacked by the Thinking Machines in 188 BG. Most of the towns were trampled and the inhabitants murdered and settlements became unusable.

The few survivors to be rescued were transported to Giedi Prime. Category:Landmarks Category:Planets
entities.short_description: Peridot Colony was a human colony. The Army of the Jihad had no presence in the area.

entities.name: Pilargo
entities.description:
Pilargo was a foggy planet whence the Caladan primitives were believed to originate.

It was visited by Paulus Atreides and Leto when young.
entities.short_description: Pilargo was a foggy planet whence the Caladan primitives were believed to originate.

entities.name: Pital
entities.description:
Pital was a human-occupied world colonized during The Scattering, and one of the first attacked during the final plan to exterminate human-kind by Omnius and the reborn Thinking Machine Empire, during the advent of Kralizec.

With the planets Ronto and Duvalle, Pital experienced first what would be Omnius's plan to wipe out humanity. Probes seeded with the dreaded Omnius Scourge were first sent to the plant first, which would nearly wipe out the population of the world. Then the survivors would be barely able to defend the world against the Thinking Machine's million-starship space Armada.

Category:Planets Category:Sequels of Dune

entities.name: Planet of the Handlers
entities.description:
The Planet of the Handlers was a name given by the Ithaca crew to an arboreal world in Human-Scattering space, which was the home-world of both the futars and their maters, whom they called Handlers. It is not known what the Handlers called the world.

When the no-ship, the Ithaca, found itself above an arboreal and lush world after a prescience-guided jump by the ghola of Miles Teg, the futars aboard the vessel began acting nervously, and Hrrm, their leader declared they had come to 'home', the home planet of the Handlers and Futars.

The leader of the Handlers on that particular district of the planet was named Orak Tho, and he invited the landing party of the Ithaca to observe a hunt of the Honored Matres. He also told Sheeana Brugh, the leader of the no-ship's landing party, that the Ithaca futars were invited to participate in the hunt. The Ithaca crew had gone down to the jungle world in one group, but were soon separated into two separate parties guided by the futar's Handlers. This caused Sheeana and Miles Teg to be in one group; and the Jewish Rabbi, and the ghola of Thufir Hawat, to be in the second group. The entire group, now in two separate observation decks of the Hunt; separated by a kilometer, was especially on guard.

After the futars killed some Honored Matres, the Matres ended up killing one of the Handlers, who in actuality turned out to be Enhanced Face Dancers, under the control of the Thinking Machine leaders Omnius and Erasmus. Sheeana and Miles were shocked that the Handlers were indeed Face Dancers, and that the landing party were to be the next victims. Sheeana immediately yelled out to Hawat and the Rabbi, in the other observation pod, to get back to the Ithaca by any means necessary. Miles re-awakened his faster-than-sight fighting abilities, and killed many of the Face Dancers as they stood in the way of his and Sheeana's escape back to the landing craft.

entities.description:
was the third planet in the star system Epsilon Alangue, and an established but largely quiet agricultural world within the Known Universe.

It was, according to Zensunni beliefs, the home world of the Zensunni Wanderers, though genetic testing has suggestions that Zensunni origins were from another planet and far more ancient.

Poritrin was a source of resources for the Imperium. The Fremen remembered Poritrin as their planet of origin in their songs.

entities.name: Prison planet
entities.description:
A prison planet is any planet where the entire world is dedicated to the incarceration of criminals. Under the rule of House Corrino, the Imperial Prison Planet was designated Salusa Secundus after the removal of the royal court to Kaitain.

During the rule of House Corrino nobles and loyalists of disgraced houses were exiled en masse to Tupile, a mysterious prison planet which may in fact have been a collection of such worlds.

The Dune Encyclopedia mentions a Prison Planet named Liesco II.

entities.name: Qelso
entities.description:
Qelso was a planet visited by the no-ship, the Ithaca, after a fold space jump initiated by the ghola of Duncan Idaho, twenty-four years after the vessel escaped from Chapterhouse.

The planet had been visited years earlier by Bene Gesserit Sisterhood acolytes sent out by Mother Superior Darwi Odrade, and seeded with sandworms to create a spice cycle on the lush and fertile world. By the time that the Ithaca came upon the world, sandtrout had already created a vast desert band across the mid-riff of the globe.

The inhabitants of Qelso were openly hostile to the Bene Gesserit for this reason, and killed the sister, Stokes, as soon as she revealed herself. The inhabitants held hostage the remainder of the crew that went down to the planet to investigate the situation. Duncan, who stayed invisible to the Enemy as long as he was on the Ithaca, decided to lead a rescue team of the group.

The group, which consisted of Sheeana, Teg, and notable others was released by the natives. The gholas of Stilgar and Liet-Kynes, however, stayed behind to help the bitter inhabitants adapt to the encroaching desert and the ever increasing number of sandworms on the world. Idaho, however, had made himself vulnerable to the watchful eyes of Daniel and Marty, and the Ithaca had to fold space again to safety.
entities.short_description: Qelso was a planet visited by the no-ship, the Ithaca, after a fold space jump initiated by the ghola of Duncan Idaho, twenty-four years after the vessel escaped from Chapterhouse.

entities.name: Quadra
entities.description:
Quadra was a planet inhabited prior to and during the Butlerian Jihad.

The planet was perhaps a former world of the Old Empire that had long been occupied by the Thinking Machines. Its main city was Quadra City. It was used as a major supply depot and manufacturing center. After its conquest by Omnius it was surrounded by several military battle stations.

One of the human slaves was Borys, a former Ginaz Swordmaster, who begun spreading his plans among the cowed humans and gauging the other prisoners. He had carefully culled out those willing to fight for their freedom and his handpicked lieutenants were dispersed across Quadra.

Quadra was one of the final targets of the Great Purge, although it posed a significant challenge, being more heavily fortified than most other Synchronized Worlds. The Purge fleet group commanded by Vorian Atreides first attacked the artificial moons before the atomic launch. Borys and his followers were filled with hope and begun the rebellion, destroying machinery and attacking robots, preparing the way for the fleet's rescuers.
entities.short_description: Quadra was a planet inhabited prior to and during the Butlerian Jihad.

entities.description: Reenol was a planet that was captured by the Honored Matres at some time before the death of the Great Honored Matre called Dama.

Relicon was a planet of the League Worlds.

In 88 BG it was crushed under cymek forces led by Dante.

Revona was the sixth planet of the Canopus system. It has one satellite (Laran).

The planet was so remote that Canopus A appeared as merely a bright first-magnitude star.

It was composed entirely of helium in different phase states. From upper to lower:

entities.name: Rhisso
entities.description:
Rhisso was a planetoid, perhaps belonging to the League of Nobles. It was populated by miners.

In 166 BG sleeping gas erupted inside the living domes and the miners disappeared. They were taken as slaves by the Tleilaxu, but the event was attributed to the Thinking Machines.

entities.description: or Richesse was the fourth planet in the Eridani A star system, and was classed with Ix as supreme in machine culture since both planets escaped the more severe effects of the Butlerian Jihad. Richese was noted for miniaturization.

entities.name: Rikka's Planet
entities.description:
Rikka's Planet was one that was settled by Honored Matres during The Scattering, and had a world generated no-field shielding the globe from outside eyes. The system this planet is in is described as having a yellow sun surrounded by four rocky planets followed by two gas giants. This is strikingly similar to our own solar system.

Rikka's planet was a world where the final ghola of Duncan Idaho folded space and visited, using the no-ship the Ithaca, when fleeing from the Enemy during the advent of Kralizec. Sheeana and Garimi took a landing party down to the planet to investigate why there were no human life signs at all on the world.

The planet had evidence of a very advanced human civilization that was governed in typical Matre fashion, with ornate buildings and gaudy decor. But evidence showed that the civilization had come to a complete, abrupt halt, hundreds of years before the Ithaca's arrival. Dense vegetative overgrowth covered much of the plazcrete buildings, and most electrical and heating grids had failed.

When Sheeana's party reached what appeared to be a Matre courthouse and detention center, Sheeana activated a holo-projection of the last recorded trial. The recording showed a trial of a Matre leader and military commander, Rikka, being judged before Matre officials.

entities.name: Roc
entities.description:
The Rocs were a deadly type of Honored Matre trainee.

They were brought from Roc, and were trained in the Honored Matres' way.

The Rocs were employed on the Honored Matres' Gammu project. Among them was Murbella, who recognized that the Rocs "..can kill with their hands, feet, or any other movable part of their bodies. They all should carry a sign: "Dangerous in any position."

On Junction, Honored Matre Elpek recognized Murbella as one of the Rocs.
entities.short_description: The Rocs were a deadly type of Honored Matre trainee.

entities.name: Rossak
entities.description:
The planet Rossak was the fifth planet in the star system HD95424. It was the fourth stop of Zensunni Wanderers during their forced migration times, and where a Awareness spectrum narcotic that released the Other Memories of their Sayyadinas was discovered.

In 10191 AG, the Lady Jessica experienced memories of Rossak when she underwent the spice agony on Arrakis. During the ceremony, Jessica successfully changed the Water of Life poison, thus unlocking her Other memories. It was during the induced trance that she recalled moments, through Other Memory, of the original Zensunni Wanderers on the planet Poritrin, as well as Zensunni women taking awareness spectrum narcotics that unlocked genetic memory for the first time.

The Fremen of Arrakis would recall the raiders pursuing them on Rossak, through courtyards lush with greenery. This recollection would normally take place during a ceremony, along with the raids on Poritrin and Bela Tegeuse. The ceremony would normally involve the Sayyadina, and the words "We will never forgive and we will never forget".

Rossak was once visited by the Zensunnis, but they eventually were expelled by raiders.

entities.name: Salusa Secundus
entities.description:
Salusa Secundus was the third planet in the Gamma Waiping star system, and the designated homeworld of House Corrino during its early history, though it later became a prison planet after the migration of the Royal court to the paradise planet Kaitain.

Salusa Secundus is a harsh place, full of wild beasts, extreme temperatures, and difficult terrain. It is one of the only two planets in the Universe where shigawire can grow.

Salusa Secundus was remembered in Fremen tradition as being a temporary home for the Wandering Zensunni; a planet on which nine generations of the Fremen ancestors lived as slaves. However, the veracity of such a belief remains debatable.

Due to the harshness of Salusa Secundus, it became the Corrino prison planet. Those who broke imperial law and were judged guilty were sentenced to be imprisoned on the planet. Many in the empire suspected that the harshness of this world was responsible for breeding Sardaukar troops. This was a theory maintained heavily by Atreides generals, namely that the harsh environment of the planet was responsible for the development of a fierce, hardened people.

entities.name: Seban
entities.description:
Seban was the innermost planet of Canopus system. It had a mean radius of 2,380 km (much smaller in radius than Menaris) and orbits Canopus at a mean distance of 52 million km.

Seban was massive enough to hold an atmosphere, but the proximity to Canopus and the intense coronal winds effectively drove it into space. The coronal wind at times of closest approach to Canopus created a very tenuous cloud of ionized metals and gases (chiefly highly kinetic ions of iron, irenium, and melorium) which populated the trailing orbital space..

The existence of this ionic cloud was discovered by the second Dren series planetary probe during a survey of the Seban nearspace.

entities.name: Stars
entities.description:
The following stars play host to some of the worlds featured in the Dune novels.

Also known as Canopus. A white super giant and home to the planet Arrakis. Absolute magnitude -5.53. From Old Earth it was 312.7 light years away.

A trinary star system containing Alpha Centauri B (also known as Toliman), an orange main sequence star. Home to the planets Ecaz and Logi. Absolute magnitude of 5.7 (Alpha Centauri B). From Old Earth the system was 4.2 - 4.3 light years away.

A binary star system, housing the star Alpha Leporis A (also known as Arneb or Kuentsing). Home to the planet Bela Tegeuse. Alpha Leporis A had an absolute magnitude of -5.34. From Old Earth the system was 1284.1 light years away.
entities.short_description: The following stars play host to some of the worlds featured in the Dune novels.

entities.name: Synchrony
entities.description:
Synchrony was the planet capital of the Thinking Machine empire, after the empire's rebirth following the defeat at the Battle of Corrin. The constructions on Synchrony were described as a series of free-moving and flowmetal machines that moved and assembled themselves into different shapes and buildings as commanded by the Evermind.

Before the Liberation of Giedi Prime, one of the copies of Omnius on Giedi Prime launched thousands of deep space probes into the far reaches of the cosmos. Each of these probes contained the complete necessary thinking machine mechanisms to build a machine society. One of these probes landed on the planet that was going to come to be known as Synchrony.

Over a hundred years later, near the end of the Battle of Corrin, the last copy of Omnius Prime electronically launched a signal copy of itself and all copies of the Thinking Machine empire, into deep space. This electronic signal degraded as it sped through deep space, and just before it faded into oblivion, latched onto the machine society that had landed on Synchrony.

The signal re-created the Omnius Evermind and his counterpart Erasmus as leaders of the reborn Thinking Machine Empire.

entities.description:

The Stars and Planets of Frank Herbert's Dune: A Gazetteer is an article witten by Joseph M. Daniels in 1999.

The article analyses the information given by the original novels and the Dune Encyclopedia about Stars and Planets of the Duniverse. It discusses the origin of names, astrophysical proprieties, and historical places in the Duniverse and much more.

entities.description:
{Eencyclopedia}} Thuestes was a location, probably a planet.

It was given to Count Demetrios II Atreides by Emperor Henoor I in 6 BG, and House Atreides/DE had been Counts of Tantalos. During the time of Alman II the House's lands were redistributed. Alkman Atreides successfully petitioned for restoration of the County of Thuestes before the Regent Henli al-Qair in 381 AG.

The County lasted into the time of Duke Mintor Atreides, probably the last known Count Thuestes.
